title: Enhancing Financial Report Question-Answering: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation System with Reranking Analysis
summary: Financial analysts face significant challenges extracting information from lengthy 10-K reports, which often exceed 100 pages. This paper presents a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system designed to answer questions about S&P 500 financial reports and evaluates the impact of neural reranking on system performance. Our pipeline employs hybrid search combining full-text and semantic retrieval, followed by an optional reranking stage using a cross-encoder model. We conduct systematic evaluation using the FinDER benchmark dataset, comprising 1,500 queries across five experimental groups. Results demonstrate that reranking significantly improves answer quality, achieving 49.0 percent correctness for scores of 8 or above compared to 33.5 percent without reranking, representing a 15.5 percentage point improvement. Additionally, the error rate for completely incorrect answers decreases from 35.3 percent to 22.5 percent. Our findings emphasize the critical role of reranking in financial RAG systems and demonstrate performance improvements over baseline methods through modern language models and refined retrieval strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的系统，用于从冗长的10-K财务报告中提取信息，并通过神经重排序技术显著提升了系统性能。
AI.motivation: 金融分析师在处理超过100页的10-K财务报告时面临信息提取困难，需要更有效的工具来快速获取关键信息。
AI.method: 采用混合检索（全文检索和语义检索）的RAG系统，可选使用交叉编码器模型进行神经重排序，并在FinDER基准数据集上进行系统评估。
AI.result: 重排序显著提升答案质量：8分以上正确率从33.5%提升至49.0%（提升15.5个百分点），完全错误率从35.3%降至22.5%。
AI.conclusion: 重排序在金融RAG系统中起关键作用，通过现代语言模型和优化检索策略可显著提升性能。

title: LLM NL2SQL Robustness: Surface Noise vs. Linguistic Variation in Traditional and Agentic Settings
summary: Robustness evaluation for Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) systems is essential because real-world database environments are dynamic, noisy, and continuously evolving, whereas conventional benchmark evaluations typically assume static schemas and well-formed user inputs. In this work, we introduce a robustness evaluation benchmark containing approximately ten types of perturbations and conduct evaluations under both traditional and agentic settings. We assess multiple state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs), including Grok-4.1, Gemini-3-Pro, Claude-Opus-4.6, and GPT-5.2. Our results show that these models generally maintain strong performance under several perturbations; however, notable performance degradation is observed for surface-level noise (e.g., character-level corruption) and linguistic variation that preserves semantics while altering lexical or syntactic forms. Furthermore, we observe that surface-level noise causes larger performance drops in traditional pipelines, whereas linguistic variation presents greater challenges in agentic settings. These findings highlight the remaining challenges in achieving robust NL2SQL systems, particularly in handling linguistic variability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对自然语言转SQL系统的鲁棒性评估基准，包含约10种扰动类型，在传统和智能体两种设置下评估了多个先进大语言模型，发现表面噪声和语义保持的语言变异是主要挑战。
AI.motivation: 现实世界数据库环境是动态、嘈杂且不断演变的，而传统的基准评估通常假设静态模式和完善的用户输入，因此需要对NL2SQL系统进行鲁棒性评估。
AI.method: 引入包含约10种扰动类型的鲁棒性评估基准，在传统和智能体两种设置下评估多个先进LLM（Grok-4.1、Gemini-3-Pro、Claude-Opus-4.6、GPT-5.2）。
AI.result: 模型在多种扰动下保持较强性能，但在字符级损坏等表面噪声和保持语义但改变词汇/句法形式的语言变异方面出现显著性能下降；表面噪声对传统流水线影响更大，语言变异对智能体设置挑战更大。
AI.conclusion: NL2SQL系统在鲁棒性方面仍面临挑战，特别是在处理语言变异方面需要进一步改进。

title: Generative AI-assisted Participatory Modeling in Socio-Environmental Planning under Deep Uncertainty
summary: Socio-environmental planning under deep uncertainty requires researchers to identify and conceptualize problems before exploring policies and deploying plans. In practice and model-based planning approaches, this problem conceptualization process often relies on participatory modeling to translate stakeholders' natural-language descriptions into a quantitative model, making this process complex and time-consuming. To facilitate this process, we propose a templated workflow that uses large language models for an initial conceptualization process. During the workflow, researchers can use large language models to identify the essential model components from stakeholders' intuitive problem descriptions, explore their diverse perspectives approaching the problem, assemble these components into a unified model, and eventually implement the model in Python through iterative communication. These results will facilitate the subsequent socio-environmental planning under deep uncertainty steps. Using ChatGPT 5.2 Instant, we demonstrated this workflow on the lake problem and an electricity market problem, both of which demonstrate socio-environmental planning problems. In both cases, acceptable outputs were obtained after a few iterations with human verification and refinement. These experiments indicated that large language models can serve as an effective tool for facilitating participatory modeling in the problem conceptualization process in socio-environmental planning.

AI.tldr: 提出基于大语言模型的模板化工作流程，用于社会-环境规划中的问题概念化过程，通过将利益相关者的自然语言描述转化为量化模型，加速参与式建模。
AI.motivation: 社会-环境规划在深度不确定性下需要先识别和概念化问题，但传统参与式建模过程复杂耗时，需要将利益相关者的自然语言描述转化为定量模型。
AI.method: 提出模板化工作流程，利用大语言模型（ChatGPT 5.2 Instant）从利益相关者的直观问题描述中识别关键模型组件，探索不同视角，组装统一模型，并通过迭代通信在Python中实现模型。
AI.result: 在湖泊问题和电力市场问题两个社会-环境规划案例中，经过几次迭代和人工验证与细化后，获得了可接受的输出结果。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型可以作为社会-环境规划问题概念化过程中参与式建模的有效工具，促进后续深度不确定性下的规划步骤。

title: Evaluating Ill-Defined Tasks in Large Language Models
summary: Many evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) target tasks that are inherently ill-defined, with unclear input and output spaces and ambiguous success criteria. We analyze why existing evaluation benchmarks and metrics fail to provide reliable or diagnostic signals of model capability for such tasks. We examine two case studies: Complex Instruction Following (CIF), where we identify recurring issues including limited coverage of real-world instruction complexity, sensitivity to instruction phrasing, inconsistent and non-comparable metrics, and instability introduced by LLM-based judges; and Natural Language to Mermaid Sequence Diagrams (NL2Mermaid), where we show how multi-faceted evaluation criteria can yield actionable insights beyond aggregate scores. Together, these case studies show that current evaluations frequently conflate distinct failure modes, yielding scores that are unstable, non-diagnostic, and difficult to act upon. Our findings expose fundamental limitations in existing evaluation practices for ill-defined tasks and motivate more robust, interpretable evaluation designs.

AI.tldr: 论文分析现有大语言模型评估方法在定义不明确任务上的局限性，通过复杂指令遵循和自然语言转Mermaid序列图两个案例研究，揭示当前评估基准存在的问题，并提出更稳健、可解释的评估设计需求。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型的评估主要针对定义不明确的任务，这些任务具有输入输出空间不清晰、成功标准模糊的特点。现有评估基准和指标无法为这类任务提供可靠或诊断性的模型能力信号，需要深入分析其根本局限性。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，分析两个具体任务：复杂指令遵循（CIF）和自然语言转Mermaid序列图（NL2Mermaid）。对于CIF，识别了包括真实世界指令复杂性覆盖不足、对指令措辞敏感、指标不一致且不可比较、以及基于LLM的评估者引入的不稳定性等反复出现的问题。对于NL2Mermaid，展示了多维度评估标准如何能够提供超越聚合分数的可操作见解。
AI.result: 研究发现当前评估经常混淆不同的失败模式，产生的分数不稳定、缺乏诊断性且难以采取行动。具体而言，CIF评估存在覆盖范围有限、对微小措辞变化敏感、指标不一致以及LLM评估者引入的不稳定性等问题；NL2Mermaid的多维度评估则能够提供更丰富的诊断信息。
AI.conclusion: 现有评估方法在定义不明确任务上存在根本局限性，经常产生不稳定、非诊断性且难以解释的评估结果。研究结果揭示了当前评估实践的不足，并推动了更稳健、可解释的评估设计需求，强调需要开发能够区分不同失败模式并提供可操作见解的评估框架。

title: Transformers are Bayesian Networks
summary:
Transformers are the dominant architecture in AI, yet why they work remains poorly understood. This paper offers a precise answer: a transformer is a Bayesian network. We establish this in five ways.
  First, we prove that every sigmoid transformer with any weights implements weighted loopy belief propagation on its implicit factor graph. One layer is one round of BP. This holds for any weights -- trained, random, or constructed. Formally verified against standard mathematical axioms.
  Second, we give a constructive proof that a transformer can implement exact belief propagation on any declared knowledge base. On knowledge bases without circular dependencies this yields provably correct probability estimates at every node. Formally verified against standard mathematical axioms.
  Third, we prove uniqueness: a sigmoid transformer that produces exact posteriors necessarily has BP weights. There is no other path through the sigmoid architecture to exact posteriors. Formally verified against standard mathematical axioms.
  Fourth, we delineate the AND/OR boolean structure of the transformer layer: attention is AND, the FFN is OR, and their strict alternation is Pearl's gather/update algorithm exactly.
  Fifth, we confirm all formal results experimentally, corroborating the Bayesian network characterization in practice. We also establish the practical viability of loopy belief propagation despite the current lack of a theoretical convergence guarantee.
  We further prove that verifiable inference requires a finite concept space. Any finite verification procedure can distinguish at most finitely many concepts. Without grounding, correctness is not defined. Hallucination is not a bug that scaling can fix. It is the structural consequence of operating without concepts. Formally verified against standard mathematical axioms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Transformer本质上是贝叶斯网络，通过五种方式证明：1) sigmoid transformer实现加权循环置信传播；2) transformer可实现精确置信传播；3) 唯一性证明；4) 揭示Transformer层的AND/OR布尔结构；5) 实验验证。同时证明可验证推理需要有限概念空间。
AI.motivation: Transformer在AI中占据主导地位，但其工作原理仍不清楚。本文旨在提供精确解释：Transformer是贝叶斯网络，揭示其数学本质和推理机制。
AI.method: 通过五种证明方法：1) 形式化证明sigmoid transformer实现加权循环置信传播；2) 构造性证明transformer可实现精确置信传播；3) 唯一性证明；4) 分析Transformer层的AND/OR布尔结构；5) 实验验证。所有证明均基于标准数学公理进行形式化验证。
AI.result: 成功证明Transformer本质上是贝叶斯网络，其层对应置信传播轮次，注意力机制对应AND操作，前馈网络对应OR操作。实验验证了贝叶斯网络表征的实际可行性，并证明循环置信传播在实践中可行。
AI.conclusion: Transformer是贝叶斯网络，其工作原理可通过置信传播解释。可验证推理需要有限概念空间，否则会产生幻觉问题。这为理解Transformer提供了数学基础，并揭示了其局限性。

title: Tokenization vs. Augmentation: A Systematic Study of Writer Variance in IMU-Based Online Handwriting Recognition
summary: Inertial measurement unit-based online handwriting recognition enables the recognition of input signals collected across different writing surfaces but remains challenged by uneven character distributions and inter-writer variability. In this work, we systematically investigate two strategies to address these issues: sub-word tokenization and concatenation-based data augmentation. Our experiments on the OnHW-Words500 dataset reveal a clear dichotomy between handling inter-writer and intra-writer variance. On the writer-independent split, structural abstraction via Bigram tokenization significantly improves performance to unseen writing styles, reducing the word error rate (WER) from 15.40% to 12.99%. In contrast, on the writer-dependent split, tokenization degrades performance due to vocabulary distribution shifts between the training and validation sets. Instead, our proposed concatenation-based data augmentation acts as a powerful regularizer, reducing the character error rate by 34.5% and the WER by 25.4%. Further analysis shows that short, low-level tokens benefit model performance and that concatenation-based data augmentation performance gain surpasses those achieved by proportionally extended training. These findings reveal a clear variance-dependent effect: sub-word tokenization primarily mitigates inter-writer stylistic variability, whereas concatenation-based data augmentation effectively compensates for intra-writer distributional sparsity.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统探讨了两种策略来解决IMU手写识别中的字符分布不均和书写者间差异问题：子词分词和基于拼接的数据增强。实验发现子词分词主要缓解书写者间风格差异，而数据增强则有效补偿书写者内分布稀疏性。
AI.motivation: 基于惯性测量单元(IMU)的在线手写识别虽然能在不同书写表面上收集输入信号，但仍面临字符分布不均和书写者间差异的挑战。需要有效策略来处理这些变异性问题。
AI.method: 研究系统调查了两种策略：1) 子词分词（特别是Bigram分词），通过结构抽象处理书写者间差异；2) 基于拼接的数据增强，通过正则化处理书写者内分布稀疏性。在OnHW-Words500数据集上进行实验，分别评估书写者独立和书写者依赖两种分割方式。
AI.result: 在书写者独立分割中，Bigram分词显著提升性能，将词错误率从15.40%降至12.99%。在书写者依赖分割中，分词反而降低性能，而基于拼接的数据增强作为强大正则化器，将字符错误率降低34.5%，词错误率降低25.4%。短的低级分词有利于模型性能，数据增强的效果超过按比例延长训练的效果。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现明显的方差依赖效应：子词分词主要缓解书写者间风格变异性，而基于拼接的数据增强有效补偿书写者内分布稀疏性。这两种策略针对不同类型的变异性问题具有互补作用。

title: Large Reasoning Models Struggle to Transfer Parametric Knowledge Across Scripts
summary: In this work, we analyze shortcomings in cross-lingual knowledge transfer in large, modern reasoning LLMs. We demonstrate that the perceived gap in knowledge transfer is primarily a script barrier. First, we conduct an observational data analysis on the performance of thinking models on two datasets with local knowledge from around the world, ECLeKTic and MultiLoKo. Our regression analysis shows that script match - not language or family - is the primary predictor of knowledge transfer failure once model capability and question difficulty are accounted for. We further this finding by providing the LLMs with the key entities of the questions in their source language and find that this disproportionately improves cross-script questions. We then posit that these LLMs could be reasoning better at test-time. To evaluate this, we develop a synthetic generation pipeline to design SFT samples to encourage the model to better reason about transliteration ambiguities when trying to fetch parametric knowledge at inference-time. We show that teaching two models to reason better reduces the cross-script transfer gap. As a result, we conclude that there is potential to improve cross-lingual parametric knowledge transfer during post-training.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型推理LLM的跨语言知识迁移主要受文字脚本障碍影响，而非语言本身。通过改进推理机制和训练方法，可以显著减少跨脚本知识迁移的差距。
AI.motivation: 分析现代大型推理LLM在跨语言知识迁移中的不足，特别是识别影响知识转移的主要障碍因素。
AI.method: 1) 在ECLeKTic和MultiLoKo数据集上进行观察性数据分析；2) 回归分析确定脚本匹配是知识迁移失败的主要预测因素；3) 为LLM提供源语言关键实体进行测试；4) 开发合成生成管道创建SFT样本，改进模型在推理时处理音译歧义的能力。
AI.result: 脚本匹配（而非语言或语系）是知识迁移失败的主要预测因素；为模型提供源语言关键实体能显著改善跨脚本问题；通过改进推理机制训练可以缩小跨脚本迁移差距。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言参数知识迁移在训练后阶段有改进潜力，主要障碍是文字脚本而非语言本身，通过改进推理机制可以显著提升跨脚本知识迁移效果。

title: Cascade-Aware Multi-Agent Routing: Spatio-Temporal Sidecars and Geometry-Switching
summary:
A common architectural pattern in advanced AI reasoning systems is the symbolic graph network: specialized agents or modules connected by delegation edges, routing tasks through a dynamic execution graph. Current schedulers optimize load and fitness but are geometry-blind: they do not model how failures propagate differently in tree-like versus cyclic regimes. In tree-like delegation, a single failure can cascade exponentially; in dense cyclic graphs, failures tend to self-limit. We identify this observability gap, quantify its system-level cost, and propose a lightweight mitigation.
  We formulate online geometry control for route-risk estimation on time-indexed execution graphs with route-local failure history. Our approach combines (i) a Euclidean spatio-temporal propagation baseline, (ii) a hyperbolic route-risk model with temporal decay (and optional burst excitation), and (iii) a learned geometry selector over structural features. The selector is a compact MLP (9->12->1) using six topology statistics plus three geometry-aware signals: BFS shell-growth slope, cycle-rank norm, and fitted Poincare curvature. On the Genesis 3 benchmark distribution, adaptive switching improves win rate in the hardest non_tree regime from 64-72% (fixed hyperbolic variants) to 92%, and achieves 87.2% overall win rate.
  To measure total system value, we compare against Genesis 3 routing without any spatio-temporal sidecar, using only native bandit/LinUCB signals (team fitness and mean node load). This baseline achieves 50.4% win rate overall and 20% in tree-like regimes; the full sidecar recovers 87.2% overall (+36.8 pp), with +48 to +68 pp gains in tree-like settings, consistent with a cascade-sensitivity analysis. Overall, a 133-parameter sidecar substantially mitigates geometry-blind failure propagation in one high-capability execution-graph system.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种针对符号图网络的几何感知调度方法，通过结合欧几里得和双曲几何模型来优化故障传播，在Genesis 3基准测试中将最难的非树状场景的胜率从64-72%提升到92%。
AI.motivation: 当前AI推理系统中的符号图网络调度器存在几何盲区：它们无法区分树状结构与循环结构中故障传播的不同模式。树状委托中单个故障可能指数级级联，而密集循环图中故障往往自限。这种可观测性差距导致了系统级成本。
AI.method: 提出了在线几何控制方法，结合三种组件：(1)欧几里得时空传播基线；(2)具有时间衰减的双曲路由风险模型；(3)基于结构特征的几何选择器（紧凑的9->12->1 MLP），使用六个拓扑统计量和三个几何感知信号：BFS壳增长斜率、循环秩范数和拟合的庞加莱曲率。
AI.result: 在Genesis 3基准分布上，自适应切换方法将最难非树状场景的胜率从64-72%提升到92%，整体胜率达到87.2%。相比仅使用原生信号的基线（50.4%胜率），几何感知方法在树状场景中带来48-68个百分点的提升，整体提升36.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 仅133个参数的轻量级辅助系统能显著缓解符号图网络中的几何盲故障传播问题，证明了在高级AI推理系统中考虑执行图几何结构的重要性。

title: Ensemble Self-Training for Unsupervised Machine Translation
summary: We present an ensemble-driven self-training framework for unsupervised neural machine translation (UNMT). Starting from a primary language pair, we train multiple UNMT models that share the same translation task but differ in an auxiliary language, inducing structured diversity across models. We then generate pseudo-translations for the primary pair using token-level ensemble decoding, averaging model predictions in both directions. These ensemble outputs are used as synthetic parallel data to further train each model, allowing the models to improve via shared supervision. At deployment time, we select a single model by validation performance, preserving single-model inference cost. Experiments show statistically significant improvements over single-model UNMT baselines, with mean gains of 1.7 chrF when translating from English and 0.67 chrF when translating into English.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于集成学习的自训练框架，用于无监督神经机器翻译。通过训练多个共享主要语言对但使用不同辅助语言的模型来引入多样性，然后使用集成解码生成伪翻译作为训练数据，最终选择单个最佳模型进行部署。
AI.motivation: 无监督神经机器翻译（UNMT）通常使用单一模型，性能有限。本文旨在通过集成学习方法提升UNMT性能，同时保持推理时的单模型成本。
AI.method: 1. 训练多个UNMT模型，这些模型共享主要语言对但使用不同的辅助语言来引入多样性；2. 使用词级集成解码为原始语言对生成伪翻译；3. 将集成输出作为合成平行数据进一步训练每个模型；4. 部署时根据验证性能选择单个最佳模型。
AI.result: 实验显示该方法在统计上显著优于单模型UNMT基线：从英语翻译时平均提升1.7 chrF，翻译成英语时平均提升0.67 chrF。
AI.conclusion: 提出的集成驱动自训练框架有效提升了无监督神经机器翻译的性能，通过模型多样性引入和集成解码生成高质量伪翻译，同时保持了部署时的单模型推理成本。

title: How Clued up are LLMs? Evaluating Multi-Step Deductive Reasoning in a Text-Based Game Environment
summary: Deducing whodunit proves challenging for LLM agents. In this paper, we implement a text-based multi-agent version of the classic board game Clue as a rule-based testbed for evaluating multi-step deductive reasoning, with six agents drawn from GPT-4o-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash. We further investigate whether fine-tuning on structured logic puzzles transfers to improved in-game reasoning and gameplay. Across 18 simulated games, agents achieve only four correct wins, indicating difficulty in maintaining consistent deductive reasoning over the course of a full game. Additionally, we find that fine-tuning does not reliably improve performance and, in some cases, appears to increase reasoning volume without improving reasoning precision.

AI.tldr: LLM智能体在文本版《妙探寻凶》游戏中表现不佳，仅18局中获胜4局，显示多步演绎推理能力有限，微调也未能可靠提升推理精度。
AI.motivation: 评估LLM智能体在多步演绎推理任务中的表现，特别是通过经典桌游《妙探寻凶》作为基于规则的测试平台，并研究微调对推理能力的迁移效果。
AI.method: 实现文本版《妙探寻凶》多智能体游戏，使用GPT-4o-mini和Gemini-2.5-Flash共6个智能体进行18局模拟游戏，并研究在结构化逻辑谜题上进行微调是否能提升游戏推理表现。
AI.result: 智能体表现不佳，仅获得4次正确胜利，表明在完整游戏中维持一致的演绎推理存在困难。微调未能可靠提升性能，有时甚至增加推理量而不提高推理精度。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM智能体在多步演绎推理任务中仍面临挑战，微调对复杂推理能力的迁移效果有限，需要更有效的推理能力提升方法。

title: AI Scientist via Synthetic Task Scaling
summary: With the advent of AI agents, automatic scientific discovery has become a tenable goal. Many recent works scaffold agentic systems that can perform machine learning research, but don't offer a principled way to train such agents -- and current LLMs often generate plausible-looking but ineffective ideas. To make progress on training agents that can learn from doing, we provide a novel synthetic environment generation pipeline targeting machine learning agents. Our pipeline automatically synthesizes machine learning challenges compatible with the SWE-agent framework, covering topic sampling, dataset proposal, and code generation. The resulting synthetic tasks are 1) grounded in real machine learning datasets, because the proposed datasets are verified against the Huggingface API and are 2) verified for higher quality with a self-debugging loop. To validate the effectiveness of our synthetic tasks, we tackle MLGym, a benchmark for machine learning tasks. From the synthetic tasks, we sample trajectories from a teacher model (GPT-5), then use the trajectories to train a student model (Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B). The student models trained with our synthetic tasks achieve improved performance on MLGym, raising the AUP metric by 9% for Qwen3-4B and 12% for Qwen3-8B.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种针对机器学习代理的合成环境生成管道，能够自动创建基于真实数据集的机器学习挑战任务，并通过自调试循环确保质量。使用该管道生成的合成任务训练学生模型，在MLGym基准测试中显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理的发展，自动科学发现成为可行目标。现有工作虽然构建了能够进行机器学习研究的代理系统，但缺乏训练这些代理的原则性方法，且当前LLM经常生成看似合理但无效的想法。需要训练能够从实践中学习的代理。
AI.method: 提出新颖的合成环境生成管道，针对机器学习代理自动合成与SWE-agent框架兼容的机器学习挑战。管道包括主题采样、数据集提议和代码生成，生成的任务基于真实机器学习数据集（通过Huggingface API验证），并通过自调试循环确保更高质量。
AI.result: 使用合成任务训练学生模型（Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B），在MLGym基准测试中显著提升了性能：Qwen3-4B的AUP指标提升了9%，Qwen3-8B提升了12%。
AI.conclusion: 该合成环境生成管道能够有效训练机器学习代理，通过基于真实数据集的合成任务和自调试机制，显著提升了代理在机器学习任务上的性能，为自动科学发现提供了有效的训练方法。

title: Knowledge Localization in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs Using Cross-Lingual Inconsistency
summary: Modern LLMs continue to exhibit significant variance in behavior across languages, such as being able to recall factual information in some languages but not others. While typically studied as a problem to be mitigated, in this work, we propose leveraging this cross-lingual inconsistency as a tool for interpretability in mixture-of-experts (MoE) LLMs. Our knowledge localization framework contrasts routing for sets of languages where the model correctly recalls information from languages where it fails. This allows us to isolate model components that play a functional role in answering about a piece of knowledge. Our method proceeds in two stages: (1) querying the model with difficult factual questions across a diverse set of languages to generate "success" and "failure" activation buckets and then (2) applying a statistical contrastive analysis to the MoE router logits to identify experts important for knowledge. To validate the necessity of this small number of experts for answering a knowledge question, we deactivate them and re-ask the question. We find that despite only deactivating about 20 out of 6000 experts, the model no longer answers correctly in over 40% of cases. Generally, this method provides a realistic and scalable knowledge localization approach to address increasingly complex LLMs.

AI.tldr: 利用MoE LLMs中跨语言不一致性进行知识定位的框架，通过对比成功与失败语言的路由模式来识别关键专家
AI.motivation: 现代LLMs在不同语言间存在显著的行为差异，通常被视为需要缓解的问题。本研究提出利用这种跨语言不一致性作为MoE LLMs的可解释性工具，通过对比模型在不同语言中回忆信息的能力差异来定位知识相关的模型组件。
AI.method: 方法分为两个阶段：(1) 用困难的事实性问题查询模型，生成"成功"和"失败"激活桶；(2) 对MoE路由器logits进行统计对比分析，识别对知识重要的专家。通过停用这些专家来验证其必要性。
AI.result: 研究发现，尽管只停用了约20个专家（总共6000个），模型在超过40%的情况下不再能正确回答问题。这表明该方法能有效定位知识相关的模型组件。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种现实且可扩展的知识定位方法，能够应对日益复杂的LLMs，将跨语言不一致性从问题转化为可解释性工具。

title: Draft-and-Prune: Improving the Reliability of Auto-formalization for Logical Reasoning
summary: Auto-formalization (AF) translates natural-language reasoning problems into solver-executable programs, enabling symbolic solvers to perform sound logical deduction. In practice, however, AF pipelines are currently brittle: programs may fail to execute, or execute but encode incorrect semantics. While prior work largely mitigates syntactic failures via repairs based on solver feedback, reducing semantics failures remains a major bottleneck. We propose Draft-and-Prune (D&P), an inference-time framework that improves AF-based logical reasoning via diversity and verification. D&P first drafts multiple natural-language plans and conditions program generation on them. It further prunes executable but contradictory or ambiguous formalizations, and aggregates predictions from surviving paths via majority voting. Across four representative benchmarks (AR-LSAT, ProofWriter, PrOntoQA, LogicalDeduction), D&P substantially strengthens AF-based reasoning without extra supervision. On AR-LSAT, in the AF-only setting, D&P achieves 78.43% accuracy with GPT-4 and 78.00% accuracy with GPT-4o, significantly outperforming the strongest AF baselines MAD-LOGIC and CLOVER. D&P then attains near-ceiling performance on the other benchmarks, including 100% on PrOntoQA and LogicalDeduction.

AI.tldr: Draft-and-Prune (D&P)框架通过多样化和验证改进自动形式化的逻辑推理，首先生成多个自然语言计划，然后修剪矛盾或模糊的形式化，最后通过多数投票聚合预测，显著提升多个基准测试的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前自动形式化（AF）管道脆弱，程序可能执行失败或编码错误语义。虽然先前工作通过基于求解器反馈的修复缓解了语法失败，但减少语义失败仍然是主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Draft-and-Prune（D&P）推理时框架：1）起草多个自然语言计划并基于这些计划生成程序；2）修剪可执行但矛盾或模糊的形式化；3）通过多数投票聚合幸存路径的预测。
AI.result: 在四个代表性基准测试（AR-LSAT、ProofWriter、PrOntoQA、LogicalDeduction）上，D&P显著增强了基于AF的推理。在AR-LSAT上，仅使用AF设置时，D&P在GPT-4上达到78.43%准确率，在GPT-4o上达到78.00%，显著优于最强的AF基线MAD-LOGIC和CLOVER。在其他基准测试上达到接近上限的性能，包括PrOntoQA和LogicalDeduction的100%。
AI.conclusion: D&P框架通过多样化和验证机制，无需额外监督即可有效改进自动形式化的逻辑推理能力，显著减少语义失败并提高推理准确性。

title: Look Where It Matters: High-Resolution Crops Retrieval for Efficient VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) typically process images at a native high-resolution, forcing a trade-off between accuracy and computational efficiency: high-resolution inputs capture fine details but incur significant computational costs, while low-resolution inputs advocate for efficiency, they potentially miss critical visual information, like small text. We present AwaRes, a spatial-on-demand framework that resolves this accuracy-efficiency trade-off by operating on a low-resolution global view and using tool-calling to retrieve only high-resolution segments needed for a given query. We construct supervised data automatically: a judge compares low- vs.\ high-resolution answers to label whether cropping is needed, and an oracle grounding model localizes the evidence for the correct answer, which we map to a discrete crop set to form multi-turn tool-use trajectories. We train our framework with cold-start SFT followed by multi-turn GRPO with a composite reward that combines semantic answer correctness with explicit crop-cost penalties. Project page: https://nimrodshabtay.github.io/AwaRes

AI.tldr: AwaRes是一个空间按需框架，通过低分辨率全局视图和工具调用检索高分辨率片段来解决视觉语言模型中精度与效率的权衡问题
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型通常需要处理高分辨率图像，这导致精度与计算效率之间的权衡：高分辨率输入能捕捉细节但计算成本高，低分辨率输入效率高但可能丢失关键视觉信息（如小文本）
AI.method: 构建监督数据：通过比较低分辨率与高分辨率答案判断是否需要裁剪，使用oracle grounding模型定位证据并映射到离散裁剪集形成多轮工具使用轨迹。采用冷启动SFT和多轮GRPO训练，结合语义答案正确性和裁剪成本惩罚的复合奖励
AI.result: 项目页面已建立，但论文中未提供具体实验结果数据
AI.conclusion: AwaRes框架通过空间按需方法有效解决了视觉语言模型中精度与计算效率的权衡问题，实现了在保持准确性的同时提高计算效率

title: Exploiting the English Grammar Profile for L2 grammatical analysis with LLMs
summary: Evaluating the grammatical competence of second language (L2) learners is essential both for providing targeted feedback and for assessing proficiency. To achieve this, we propose a novel framework leveraging the English Grammar Profile (EGP), a taxonomy of grammatical constructs mapped to the proficiency levels of the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR), to detect learners' attempts at grammatical constructs and classify them as successful or unsuccessful. This detection can then be used to provide fine-grained feedback. Moreover, the grammatical constructs are used as predictors of proficiency assessment by using automatically detected attempts as predictors of holistic CEFR proficiency. For the selection of grammatical constructs derived from the EGP, rule-based and LLM-based classifiers are compared. We show that LLMs outperform rule-based methods on semantically and pragmatically nuanced constructs, while rule-based approaches remain competitive for constructs that rely purely on morphological or syntactic features and do not require semantic interpretation. For proficiency assessment, we evaluate both rule-based and hybrid pipelines and show that a hybrid approach combining a rule-based pre-filter with an LLM consistently yields the strongest performance. Since our framework operates on pairs of original learner sentences and their corrected counterparts, we also evaluate a fully automated pipeline using automatic grammatical error correction. This pipeline closely approaches the performance of semi-automated systems based on manual corrections, particularly for the detection of successful attempts at grammatical constructs. Overall, our framework emphasises learners' successful attempts in addition to unsuccessful ones, enabling positive, formative feedback and providing actionable insights into grammatical development.

AI.tldr: 提出基于英语语法轮廓(EGP)的框架，检测二语学习者语法结构尝试并分类成功/失败，用于细粒度反馈和CEFR水平评估
AI.motivation: 评估二语学习者的语法能力对于提供针对性反馈和评估熟练度至关重要，需要一种能够检测学习者语法结构尝试并分类成功与否的系统化方法
AI.method: 利用英语语法轮廓(EGP)分类法，将语法结构与CEFR水平对应，比较基于规则和LLM的分类器，评估混合方法，并使用自动语法纠错构建全自动流程
AI.result: LLM在语义和语用细微差别的结构上优于基于规则的方法，而基于规则的方法在纯形态或句法特征上仍具竞争力；混合方法结合规则预过滤和LLM表现最佳；全自动流程接近基于人工纠错的半自动系统性能
AI.conclusion: 该框架不仅关注学习者的错误，更强调成功尝试，支持积极的形成性反馈，为语法发展提供可操作的见解，混合方法在语法结构检测和熟练度评估方面均表现优异

title: Graph-Native Cognitive Memory for AI Agents: Formal Belief Revision Semantics for Versioned Memory Architectures
summary: While individual components for AI agent memory exist in prior systems, their architectural synthesis and formal grounding remain underexplored. We present Kumiho, a graph-native cognitive memory architecture grounded in formal belief revision semantics. The structural primitives required for cognitive memory -- immutable revisions, mutable tag pointers, typed dependency edges, URI-based addressing -- are identical to those required for managing agent-produced work as versionable assets, enabling a unified graph-native architecture that serves both purposes. The central formal contribution is a correspondence between the AGM belief revision framework and the operational semantics of a property graph memory system, proving satisfaction of the basic AGM postulates (K*2--K*6) and Hansson's belief base postulates (Relevance, Core-Retainment). The architecture implements a dual-store model (Redis working memory, Neo4j long-term graph) with hybrid fulltext and vector retrieval. On LoCoMo (token-level F1), Kumiho achieves 0.565 overall F1 (n=1,986) including 97.5% adversarial refusal accuracy. On LoCoMo-Plus, a Level-2 cognitive memory benchmark testing implicit constraint recall, Kumiho achieves 93.3% judge accuracy (n=401); independent reproduction by the benchmark authors yielded results in the mid-80% range, still substantially outperforming all published baselines (best: Gemini 2.5 Pro, 45.7%). Three architectural innovations drive the results: prospective indexing (LLM-generated future-scenario implications indexed at write time), event extraction (structured causal events preserved in summaries), and client-side LLM reranking. The architecture is model-decoupled: switching the answer model from GPT-4o-mini (~88%) to GPT-4o (93.3%) improves end-to-end accuracy without pipeline changes, at a total evaluation cost of ~$14 for 401 entries.

AI.tldr: Kumiho是一个基于图原生认知记忆架构的AI代理系统，通过形式化信念修正语义统一管理记忆和工作资产，在认知记忆基准测试中显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理系统中的记忆组件虽然存在，但其架构综合和形式化基础研究不足。需要一种统一架构来同时处理认知记忆和代理生成的工作资产管理。
AI.method: 提出Kumiho图原生认知记忆架构，基于形式化信念修正语义。采用双存储模型（Redis工作记忆，Neo4j长期图存储），结合混合全文和向量检索。包含前瞻索引、事件提取和客户端LLM重排三大创新。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准测试中达到0.565总体F1分数（n=1,986），包含97.5%对抗性拒绝准确率。在LoCoMo-Plus基准测试中达到93.3%判断准确率（n=401），显著优于所有已发布基线（最佳基线：Gemini 2.5 Pro，45.7%）。
AI.conclusion: Kumiho架构成功统一了认知记忆和工作资产管理，通过形式化信念修正语义提供了理论基础，在认知记忆任务上表现出色，且具有模型解耦特性，便于模型切换而不改变管道架构。

title: AgriChat: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Agriculture Image Understanding
summary: The deployment of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in agriculture is currently stalled by a critical trade-off: the existing literature lacks the large-scale agricultural datasets required for robust model development and evaluation, while current state-of-the-art models lack the verified domain expertise necessary to reason across diverse taxonomies. To address these challenges, we propose the Vision-to-Verified-Knowledge (V2VK) pipeline, a novel generative AI-driven annotation framework that integrates visual captioning with web-augmented scientific retrieval to autonomously generate the AgriMM benchmark, effectively eliminating biological hallucinations by grounding training data in verified phytopathological literature. The AgriMM benchmark contains over 3,000 agricultural classes and more than 607k VQAs spanning multiple tasks, including fine-grained plant species identification, plant disease symptom recognition, crop counting, and ripeness assessment. Leveraging this verifiable data, we present AgriChat, a specialized MLLM that presents broad knowledge across thousands of agricultural classes and provides detailed agricultural assessments with extensive explanations. Extensive evaluation across diverse tasks, datasets, and evaluation conditions reveals both the capabilities and limitations of current agricultural MLLMs, while demonstrating AgriChat's superior performance over other open-source models, including internal and external benchmarks. The results validate that preserving visual detail combined with web-verified knowledge constitutes a reliable pathway toward robust and trustworthy agricultural AI. The code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/boudiafA/AgriChat .

AI.tldr: 提出V2VK管道和AgriMM基准，解决农业多模态大语言模型缺乏大规模验证数据集的问题，并开发了AgriChat模型在农业任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 当前农业多模态大语言模型的部署面临关键权衡：缺乏大规模农业数据集用于模型开发和评估，同时现有最先进模型缺乏经过验证的领域专业知识来跨不同分类进行推理。
AI.method: 提出Vision-to-Verified-Knowledge（V2VK）管道，这是一个新颖的生成式AI驱动的标注框架，将视觉描述与网络增强的科学检索相结合，自主生成AgriMM基准，通过将训练数据基于经过验证的植物病理学文献来消除生物幻觉。
AI.result: AgriMM基准包含超过3,000个农业类别和超过607k个视觉问答，涵盖多个任务。基于这些可验证数据开发的AgriChat模型在多样化任务、数据集和评估条件下表现出色，优于其他开源模型。
AI.conclusion: 保持视觉细节与网络验证知识相结合是通向稳健可信农业AI的可靠途径。代码和数据集已公开。

title: Contrastive Reasoning Alignment: Reinforcement Learning from Hidden Representations
summary: We propose CRAFT, a red-teaming alignment framework that leverages model reasoning capabilities and hidden representations to improve robustness against jailbreak attacks. Unlike prior defenses that operate primarily at the output level, CRAFT aligns large reasoning models to generate safety-aware reasoning traces by explicitly optimizing objectives defined over the hidden state space. Methodologically, CRAFT integrates contrastive representation learning with reinforcement learning to separate safe and unsafe reasoning trajectories, yielding a latent-space geometry that supports robust, reasoning-level safety alignment. Theoretically, we show that incorporating latent-textual consistency into GRPO eliminates superficially aligned policies by ruling them out as local optima. Empirically, we evaluate CRAFT on multiple safety benchmarks using two strong reasoning models, Qwen3-4B-Thinking and R1-Distill-Llama-8B, where it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art defenses such as IPO and SafeKey. Notably, CRAFT delivers an average 79.0% improvement in reasoning safety and 87.7% improvement in final-response safety over the base models, demonstrating the effectiveness of hidden-space reasoning alignment.

AI.tldr: CRAFT是一个利用模型推理能力和隐藏表示来提升对抗越狱攻击鲁棒性的红队对齐框架，通过隐藏状态空间优化实现安全感知推理轨迹生成。
AI.motivation: 现有防御方法主要在输出层面操作，缺乏对推理过程的安全对齐。需要开发能够利用模型推理能力和隐藏表示来提升对抗越狱攻击鲁棒性的框架。
AI.method: CRAFT整合对比表示学习和强化学习，在隐藏状态空间分离安全和危险推理轨迹，通过潜在-文本一致性优化GRPO，消除表面对齐策略。
AI.result: 在多个安全基准测试中，CRAFT在Qwen3-4B-Thinking和R1-Distill-Llama-8B模型上优于IPO和SafeKey等最先进防御方法，推理安全性平均提升79.0%，最终响应安全性提升87.7%。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT通过隐藏空间推理对齐有效提升了大型推理模型的安全性，证明了在隐藏状态空间进行安全对齐的有效性，为对抗越狱攻击提供了新的防御范式。

title: GenLie: A Global-Enhanced Lie Detection Network under Sparsity and Semantic Interference
comment: Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP) 2026
summary: Video-based lie detection aims to identify deceptive behaviors from visual cues. Despite recent progress, its core challenge lies in learning sparse yet discriminative representations. Deceptive signals are typically subtle and short-lived, easily overwhelmed by redundant information, while individual and contextual variations introduce strong identity-related noise. To address this issue, we propose GenLie, a Global-Enhanced Lie Detection Network that performs local feature modeling under global supervision. Specifically, sparse and subtle deceptive cues are captured at the local level, while global supervision and optimization ensure robust and discriminative representations by suppressing identity-related noise. Experiments on three public datasets, covering both high- and low-stakes scenarios, show that GenLie consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Source code is available at https://github.com/AliasDictusZ1/GenLie.

AI.tldr: GenLie是一个基于视频的谎言检测网络，通过全局监督下的局部特征建模来学习稀疏但具有判别性的表示，有效捕捉微妙的欺骗线索并抑制身份相关噪声。
AI.motivation: 视频谎言检测的核心挑战在于学习稀疏但具有判别性的表示。欺骗信号通常微妙且短暂，容易被冗余信息淹没，而个体和上下文变化引入了强烈的身份相关噪声。
AI.method: 提出GenLie（全局增强谎言检测网络），在全局监督下进行局部特征建模。局部层面捕捉稀疏微妙的欺骗线索，全局监督和优化通过抑制身份相关噪声来确保鲁棒且具有判别性的表示。
AI.result: 在三个公共数据集（涵盖高风险和低风险场景）上的实验表明，GenLie始终优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: GenLie通过全局监督下的局部特征建模，有效解决了视频谎言检测中稀疏判别表示学习的挑战，在不同场景下都表现出优越性能。

title: CODMAS: A Dialectic Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Structured RTL Optimization
summary: Optimizing Register Transfer Level (RTL) code is a critical step in Electronic Design Automation (EDA) for improving power, performance, and area (PPA). We present CODMAS (Collaborative Optimization via a Dialectic Multi-Agent System), a framework that combines structured dialectic reasoning with domain-aware code generation and deterministic evaluation to automate RTL optimization. At the core of CODMAS are two dialectic agents: the Articulator, inspired by rubber-duck debugging, which articulates stepwise transformation plans and exposes latent assumptions; and the Hypothesis Partner, which predicts outcomes and reconciles deviations between expected and actual behavior to guide targeted refinements. These agents direct a Domain-Specific Coding Agent (DCA) to generate architecture-aware Verilog edits and a Code Evaluation Agent (CEA) to verify syntax, functionality, and PPA metrics. We introduce RTLOPT, a benchmark of 120 Verilog triples (unoptimized, optimized, testbench) for pipelining and clock-gating transformations. Across proprietary and open LLMs, CODMAS achieves ~25% reduction in critical path delay for pipelining and ~22% power reduction for clock gating, while reducing functional and compilation failures compared to strong prompting and agentic baselines. These results demonstrate that structured multi-agent reasoning can significantly enhance automated RTL optimization and scale to more complex designs and broader optimization tasks.

AI.tldr: CODMAS是一个结合结构化辩证推理与领域感知代码生成的多智能体框架，用于自动化RTL优化，在流水线和时钟门控任务中显著降低关键路径延迟和功耗。
AI.motivation: RTL代码优化是EDA中改善功耗、性能和面积的关键步骤，但传统方法存在局限。研究旨在通过结构化多智能体推理实现更高效、可靠的自动化RTL优化。
AI.method: CODMAS框架包含两个辩证智能体：Articulator（基于橡皮鸭调试，阐述逐步转换计划）和Hypothesis Partner（预测结果并协调偏差）；以及领域特定编码智能体（DCA）和代码评估智能体（CEA）。还引入了RTLOPT基准测试集。
AI.result: 在流水线优化中实现约25%的关键路径延迟降低，在时钟门控中实现约22%的功耗降低，同时相比基线方法减少了功能和编译失败率。
AI.conclusion: 结构化多智能体推理能够显著增强自动化RTL优化能力，并有望扩展到更复杂的设计和更广泛的优化任务。

title: InfoDensity: Rewarding Information-Dense Traces for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) with extended reasoning capabilities often generate verbose and redundant reasoning traces, incurring unnecessary computational cost. While existing reinforcement learning approaches address this by optimizing final response length, they neglect the quality of intermediate reasoning steps, leaving models vulnerable to reward hacking. We argue that verbosity is not merely a length problem, but a symptom of poor intermediate reasoning quality. To investigate this, we conduct an empirical study tracking the conditional entropy of the answer distribution across reasoning steps. We find that high-quality reasoning traces exhibit two consistent properties: low uncertainty convergence and monotonic progress. These findings suggest that high-quality reasoning traces are informationally dense, that is, each step contributes meaningful entropy reduction relative to the total reasoning length. Motivated by this, we propose InfoDensity, a reward framework for RL training that combines an AUC-based reward and a monotonicity reward as a unified measure of reasoning quality, weighted by a length scaling term that favors achieving equivalent quality more concisely. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that InfoDensity matches or surpasses state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy while significantly reducing token usage, achieving a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 论文提出InfoDensity奖励框架，通过结合AUC奖励和单调性奖励来优化LLM推理质量，在保持准确率的同时显著减少token使用量。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法只优化最终回答长度，忽视了中间推理步骤的质量，导致模型容易受到奖励攻击。作者认为冗余性不仅是长度问题，更是中间推理质量低下的表现。
AI.method: 通过实证研究跟踪答案分布在推理步骤中的条件熵，发现高质量推理轨迹具有低不确定性收敛和单调进展特性。基于此提出InfoDensity奖励框架，结合AUC奖励和单调性奖励来衡量推理质量，并通过长度缩放项鼓励更简洁的等效质量实现。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准测试中，InfoDensity在准确率上匹配或超越最先进基线，同时显著减少token使用量，实现了强大的准确率-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 高质量推理轨迹具有信息密集性，每个步骤都相对于总推理长度贡献有意义的熵减少。InfoDensity框架通过优化推理质量而非仅仅长度，有效解决了LLM推理冗余问题。

title: TDMM-LM: Bridging Facial Understanding and Animation via Language Models
summary: Text-guided human body animation has advanced rapidly, yet facial animation lags due to the scarcity of well-annotated, text-paired facial corpora. To close this gap, we leverage foundation generative models to synthesize a large, balanced corpus of facial behavior. We design prompts suite covering emotions and head motions, generate about 80 hours of facial videos with multiple generators, and fit per-frame 3D facial parameters, yielding large-scale (prompt and parameter) pairs for training. Building on this dataset, we probe language models for bidirectional competence over facial motion via two complementary tasks: (1) Motion2Language: given a sequence of 3D facial parameters, the model produces natural-language descriptions capturing content, style, and dynamics; and (2) Language2Motion: given a prompt, the model synthesizes the corresponding sequence of 3D facial parameters via quantized motion tokens for downstream animation. Extensive experiments show that in this setting language models can both interpret and synthesize facial motion with strong generalization. To best of our knowledge, this is the first work to cast facial-parameter modeling as a language problem, establishing a unified path for text-conditioned facial animation and motion understanding.

AI.tldr: 利用基础生成模型合成大规模面部行为数据集，通过语言模型实现面部参数与文本描述的双向转换，为文本驱动的面部动画提供统一解决方案。
AI.motivation: 文本引导的人体动画发展迅速，但面部动画因缺乏高质量文本配对的面部数据集而滞后，需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 设计涵盖情感和头部动作的提示词，生成约80小时面部视频，提取每帧3D面部参数，构建大规模（提示词-参数）配对数据集。基于此，通过Motion2Language（面部参数转文本描述）和Language2Motion（文本提示转面部参数）两个互补任务，探索语言模型在面部运动建模中的双向能力。
AI.result: 实验表明语言模型能够有效解释和合成面部运动，具有较强的泛化能力。首次将面部参数建模转化为语言问题，为文本条件面部动画和运动理解建立了统一路径。
AI.conclusion: 通过合成大规模面部行为数据集并利用语言模型实现面部参数与文本的双向转换，成功解决了文本驱动面部动画的数据稀缺问题，为面部动画领域提供了创新的统一框架。

title: SYMDIREC: A Neuro-Symbolic Divide-Retrieve-Conquer Framework for Enhanced RTL Synthesis and Summarization
summary: Register-Transfer Level (RTL) synthesis and summarization are central to hardware design automation but remain challenging for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to rigid HDL syntax, limited supervision, and weak alignment with natural language. Existing prompting and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods have not incorporated symbolic planning, limiting their structural precision. We introduce SYMDIREC, a neuro-symbolic framework that decomposes RTL tasks into symbolic subgoals, retrieves relevant code via a fine-tuned retriever, and assembles verified outputs through LLM reasoning. Supporting both Verilog and VHDL without LLM fine-tuning, SYMDIREC achieves ~20% higher Pass@1 rates for synthesis and 15-20% ROUGE-L improvements for summarization over prompting and RAG baselines, demonstrating the benefits of symbolic guidance in RTL tasks.

AI.tldr: SYMDIREC是一个神经符号框架，通过符号规划分解RTL任务，使用微调检索器获取相关代码，并通过LLM推理组装验证输出，在RTL综合和摘要任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: RTL综合和摘要对硬件设计自动化至关重要，但LLM面临HDL语法严格、监督有限以及与自然语言对齐弱等挑战。现有提示和RAG方法缺乏符号规划，限制了结构精度。
AI.method: SYMDIREC将RTL任务分解为符号子目标，通过微调检索器检索相关代码，利用LLM推理组装验证输出，支持Verilog和VHDL且无需LLM微调。
AI.result: SYMDIREC在RTL综合任务上获得约20%更高的Pass@1率，在摘要任务上实现15-20%的ROUGE-L提升，优于提示和RAG基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SYMDIREC展示了符号指导在RTL任务中的优势，通过神经符号方法有效解决了现有LLM在硬件设计自动化中的局限性。

title: Physics-informed offline reinforcement learning eliminates catastrophic fuel waste in maritime routing
summary: International shipping produces approximately 3% of global greenhouse gas emissions, yet voyage routing remains dominated by heuristic methods. We present PIER (Physics-Informed, Energy-efficient, Risk-aware routing), an offline reinforcement learning framework that learns fuel-efficient, safety-aware routing policies from physics-calibrated environments grounded in historical vessel tracking data and ocean reanalysis products, requiring no online simulator. Validated on one full year (2023) of AIS data across seven Gulf of Mexico routes (840 episodes per method), PIER reduces mean CO2 emissions by 10% relative to great-circle routing. However, PIER's primary contribution is eliminating catastrophic fuel waste: great-circle routing incurs extreme fuel consumption (>1.5x median) in 4.8% of voyages; PIER reduces this to 0.5%, a 9-fold reduction. Per-voyage fuel variance is 3.5x lower (p<0.001), with bootstrap 95% CI for mean savings [2.9%, 15.7%]. Partial validation against observed AIS vessel behavior confirms consistency with the fastest real transits while exhibiting 23.1x lower variance. Crucially, PIER is forecast-independent: unlike A* path optimization whose wave protection degrades 4.5x under realistic forecast uncertainty, PIER maintains constant performance using only local observations. The framework combines physics-informed state construction, demonstration-augmented offline data, and a decoupled post-hoc safety shield, an architecture that transfers to wildfire evacuation, aircraft trajectory optimization, and autonomous navigation in unmapped terrain.

AI.tldr: PIER是一个基于离线强化学习的船舶航线优化框架，利用物理校准环境和历史数据学习燃料高效、安全感知的航线策略，无需在线模拟器，能显著降低CO2排放和燃料浪费。
AI.motivation: 国际航运占全球温室气体排放的3%，但当前航线规划仍主要依赖启发式方法，存在燃料浪费严重、安全性不足等问题，需要更智能、高效的航线优化方案。
AI.method: PIER采用离线强化学习框架，结合物理信息状态构建、演示增强的离线数据以及解耦的后验安全屏蔽架构，基于历史船舶跟踪数据和海洋再分析产品训练，无需在线模拟器。
AI.result: 在墨西哥湾7条航线一年的验证中，PIER相比大圆航线平均减少10%的CO2排放，将极端燃料消耗（>1.5倍中位数）的发生率从4.8%降至0.5%（9倍降低），燃料方差降低3.5倍，且性能不受天气预报不确定性影响。
AI.conclusion: PIER框架能有效减少船舶燃料消耗和排放，显著降低极端燃料浪费风险，且具有预测独立性优势，其架构可推广到野火疏散、飞机轨迹优化和未知地形自主导航等领域。

title: Solution for 10th Competition on Ambivalence/Hesitancy (AH) Video Recognition Challenge using Divergence-Based Multimodal Fusion
summary: We address the Ambivalence/Hesitancy (A/H) Video Recognition Challenge at the 10th ABAW Competition (CVPR 2026). We propose a divergence-based multimodal fusion that explicitly measures cross-modal conflict between visual, audio, and textual channels. Visual features are encoded as Action Units (AUs) extracted via Py-Feat, audio via Wav2Vec 2.0, and text via BERT. Each modality is processed by a BiLSTM with attention pooling and projected into a shared embedding space. The fusion module computes pairwise absolute differences between modality embeddings, directly capturing the incongruence that characterizes A/H. On the BAH dataset, our approach achieves a Macro F1 of 0.6808 on the validation test set, outperforming the challenge baseline of 0.2827. Statistical analysis across 1{,}132 videos confirms that temporal variability of AUs is the dominant visual discriminator of A/H.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分歧的多模态融合方法，用于解决ABAW竞赛中的矛盾/犹豫视频识别挑战，通过测量视觉、音频和文本模态之间的冲突来识别矛盾/犹豫状态。
AI.motivation: 针对矛盾/犹豫（A/H）视频识别挑战，现有方法未能充分捕捉不同模态之间的冲突或不一致性，而这些冲突正是矛盾/犹豫状态的关键特征。需要一种能够显式测量跨模态冲突的方法来更好地识别A/H状态。
AI.method: 提出基于分歧的多模态融合方法：1）视觉特征通过Py-Feat提取动作单元（AUs）；2）音频特征通过Wav2Vec 2.0编码；3）文本特征通过BERT编码；4）每个模态通过BiLSTM和注意力池化处理，投影到共享嵌入空间；5）融合模块计算模态嵌入之间的绝对差异，直接捕捉表征A/H的不一致性。
AI.result: 在BAH数据集上，该方法在验证测试集上达到Macro F1为0.6808，显著优于挑战基线0.2827。对1,132个视频的统计分析确认，AUs的时间变异性是A/H的主要视觉判别因素。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于分歧的多模态融合方法能够有效捕捉跨模态冲突，显著提升矛盾/犹豫视频识别的性能。AUs的时间变异性被确认为识别A/H状态的关键视觉特征。

title: Anonymous-by-Construction: An LLM-Driven Framework for Privacy-Preserving Text
summary:
Responsible use of AI demands that we protect sensitive information without undermining the usefulness of data, an imperative that has become acute in the age of large language models. We address this challenge with an on-premise, LLM-driven substitution pipeline that anonymizes text by replacing personally identifiable information (PII) with realistic, type-consistent surrogates. Executed entirely within organizational boundaries using local LLMs, the approach prevents data egress while preserving fluency and task-relevant semantics.
  We conduct a systematic, multi-metric, cross-technique evaluation on the Action-Based Conversation Dataset, benchmarking against industry standards (Microsoft Presidio and Google DLP) and a state-of-the-art approach (ZSTS, in redaction-only and redaction-plus-substitution variants). Our protocol jointly measures privacy, semantic utility, and trainability under privacy via a lifecycle-ready criterion obtained by fine-tuning a compact encoder (BERT+LoRA) on sanitized text. In addition, we assess agentic Q&A performance by inserting an on-premise anonymization layer before the answering LLM and evaluating the quality of its responses. This intermediate, type-preserving substitution stage ensures that no sensitive content is exposed to third-party APIs, enabling responsible deployment of Q\&A agents without compromising confidentiality.
  Our method attains state-of-the-art privacy, minimal topical drift, strong factual utility, and low trainability loss, outperforming rule-based approaches and named-entity recognition (NER) baselines and ZSTS variants on the combined privacy--utility--trainability frontier. These results show that local LLM substitution yields anonymized corpora that are both responsible to use and operationally valuable: safe for agentic pipelines and suitable for downstream fine-tuning with limited degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于本地大语言模型的文本匿名化方法，通过用类型一致的替代词替换个人身份信息，在保护隐私的同时保持文本的流畅性和语义实用性。
AI.motivation: 在大型语言模型时代，如何在保护敏感信息的同时不损害数据的实用性成为一个迫切需求。需要一种既能防止数据外泄，又能保持文本语义完整性的匿名化解决方案。
AI.method: 开发了基于本地LLM的替代管道，完全在组织边界内执行，用真实、类型一致的替代词替换个人身份信息。采用多指标评估协议，包括隐私性、语义效用和可训练性评估，并在问答代理前插入匿名化层。
AI.result: 该方法在隐私保护、主题漂移最小化、事实效用和可训练性损失方面达到最先进水平，优于基于规则的方法、NER基线和ZSTS变体，在隐私-效用-可训练性综合边界上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 本地LLM替代方法能够生成既负责任又有操作价值的匿名化语料库，既安全适用于代理管道，又适合下游微调且性能下降有限，实现了隐私保护与数据实用性的平衡。

title: ShuttleEnv: An Interactive Data-Driven RL Environment for Badminton Strategy Modeling
summary: We present ShuttleEnv, an interactive and data-driven simulation environment for badminton, designed to support reinforcement learning and strategic behavior analysis in fast-paced adversarial sports. The environment is grounded in elite-player match data and employs explicit probabilistic models to simulate rally-level dynamics, enabling realistic and interpretable agent-opponent interactions without relying on physics-based simulation. In this demonstration, we showcase multiple trained agents within ShuttleEnv and provide live, step-by-step visualization of badminton rallies, allowing attendees to explore different play styles, observe emergent strategies, and interactively analyze decision-making behaviors. ShuttleEnv serves as a reusable platform for research, visualization, and demonstration of intelligent agents in sports AI. Our ShuttleEnv demo video URL: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hTR4P16U27H2O0-w316bR73pxE2ucczX/view

AI.tldr: ShuttleEnv是一个基于数据的羽毛球模拟环境，用于强化学习和策略分析，通过概率模型模拟比赛动态，支持智能体训练和交互式可视化。
AI.motivation: 开发一个交互式、数据驱动的羽毛球模拟环境，以支持快速对抗性体育中的强化学习和策略行为分析，避免依赖物理模拟。
AI.method: 基于精英选手比赛数据，采用显式概率模型模拟回合级动态，创建真实且可解释的智能体-对手交互环境。
AI.result: 展示了多个在ShuttleEnv中训练好的智能体，提供实时、逐步的羽毛球回合可视化，支持探索不同打法风格、观察涌现策略和交互式分析决策行为。
AI.conclusion: ShuttleEnv作为可重复使用的平台，可用于体育AI领域的研究、可视化和智能体演示。

title: KGS-GCN: Enhancing Sparse Skeleton Sensing via Kinematics-Driven Gaussian Splatting and Probabilistic Topology for Action Recognition
summary: Skeleton-based action recognition is widely utilized in sensor systems including human-computer interaction and intelligent surveillance. Nevertheless, current sensor devices typically generate sparse skeleton data as discrete coordinates, which inevitably discards fine-grained spatiotemporal details during highly dynamic movements. Moreover, the rigid constraints of predefined physical sensor topologies hinder the modeling of latent long-range dependencies. To overcome these limitations, we propose KGS-GCN, a graph convolutional network that integrates kinematics-driven Gaussian splatting with probabilistic topology. Our framework explicitly addresses the challenges of sensor data sparsity and topological rigidity by transforming discrete joints into continuous generative representations. Firstly, a kinematics-driven Gaussian splatting module is designed to dynamically construct anisotropic covariance matrices using instantaneous joint velocity vectors. This module enhances visual representation by rendering sparse skeleton sequences into multi-view continuous heatmaps rich in spatiotemporal semantics. Secondly, to transcend the limitations of fixed physical connections, a probabilistic topology construction method is proposed. This approach generates an adaptive prior adjacency matrix by quantifying statistical correlations via the Bhattacharyya distance between joint Gaussian distributions. Ultimately, the GCN backbone is adaptively modulated by the rendered visual features via a visual context gating mechanism. Empirical results demonstrate that KGS-GCN significantly enhances the modeling of complex spatiotemporal dynamics. By addressing the inherent limitations of sparse inputs, our framework offers a robust solution for processing low-fidelity sensor data. This approach establishes a practical pathway for improving perceptual reliability in real-world sensing applications.

AI.tldr: KGS-GCN：一种结合运动学驱动高斯泼溅与概率拓扑的图卷积网络，用于解决骨架动作识别中传感器数据稀疏性和拓扑刚性问题，将离散关节转换为连续生成表示。
AI.motivation: 当前传感器设备生成的稀疏骨架数据会丢失细粒度时空细节，且预定义物理传感器拓扑的刚性约束阻碍了潜在长距离依赖关系的建模。
AI.method: 1. 运动学驱动高斯泼溅模块：利用瞬时关节速度向量动态构建各向异性协方差矩阵，将稀疏骨架序列渲染为富含时空语义的多视图连续热图；2. 概率拓扑构建方法：通过Bhattacharyya距离量化关节高斯分布间的统计相关性，生成自适应先验邻接矩阵；3. 视觉上下文门控机制：通过渲染的视觉特征自适应调制GCN主干网络。
AI.result: KGS-GCN显著增强了复杂时空动态建模能力，通过解决稀疏输入的固有局限性，为处理低保真传感器数据提供了稳健解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为改善现实世界传感应用中的感知可靠性建立了实用途径，通过将离散关节转换为连续生成表示，有效解决了传感器数据稀疏性和拓扑刚性问题。

title: Alignment Makes Language Models Normative, Not Descriptive
summary: Post-training alignment optimizes language models to match human preference signals, but this objective is not equivalent to modeling observed human behavior. We compare 120 base-aligned model pairs on more than 10,000 real human decisions in multi-round strategic games - bargaining, persuasion, negotiation, and repeated matrix games. In these settings, base models outperform their aligned counterparts in predicting human choices by nearly 10:1, robustly across model families, prompt formulations, and game configurations. This pattern reverses, however, in settings where human behavior is more likely to follow normative predictions: aligned models dominate on one-shot textbook games across all 12 types tested and on non-strategic lottery choices - and even within the multi-round games themselves, at round one, before interaction history develops. This boundary-condition pattern suggests that alignment induces a normative bias: it improves prediction when human behavior is relatively well captured by normative solutions, but hurts prediction in multi-round strategic settings, where behavior is shaped by descriptive dynamics such as reciprocity, retaliation, and history-dependent adaptation. These results reveal a fundamental trade-off between optimizing models for human use and using them as proxies for human behavior.

AI.tldr: 对齐后的语言模型在预测人类行为时存在规范偏见：在多轮策略游戏中表现不如基础模型，但在单次教科书游戏和非策略彩票选择中表现更好
AI.motivation: 研究后训练对齐是否真正帮助语言模型预测人类行为，特别是在复杂的多轮策略交互环境中
AI.method: 比较120个基础-对齐模型对在10,000多个真实人类决策上的表现，涵盖议价、说服、谈判和重复矩阵游戏等多轮策略游戏，以及12种单次教科书游戏和非策略彩票选择
AI.result: 在多轮策略游戏中，基础模型预测人类选择的能力比对齐模型强近10倍；但在单次教科书游戏和非策略彩票选择中，对齐模型表现更好；在多轮游戏中，仅在第一轮对齐模型表现更优
AI.conclusion: 对齐会引入规范偏见：当人类行为相对符合规范解决方案时能改善预测，但在多轮策略环境中会损害预测能力，因为这些环境中的行为受互惠、报复和历史依赖适应等描述性动态影响。这揭示了优化模型供人类使用与将其作为人类行为代理之间的根本权衡

title: A Progressive Visual-Logic-Aligned Framework for Ride-Hailing Adjudication
summary: The efficient adjudication of responsibility disputes is pivotal for maintaining marketplace fairness. However, the exponential surge in ride-hailing volume renders manual review intractable, while conventional automated methods lack the reasoning transparency required for quasi-judicial decisions. Although Multimodal LLMs offer a promising paradigm, they fundamentally struggle to bridge the gap between general visual semantics and rigorous evidentiary protocols, often leading to perceptual hallucinations and logical looseness. To address these systemic misalignments, we introduce RideJudge, a Progressive Visual-Logic-Aligned Framework. Instead of relying on generic pre-training, we bridge the semantic gap via SynTraj, a synthesis engine that grounds abstract liability concepts into concrete trajectory patterns. To resolve the conflict between massive regulation volume and limited context windows, we propose an Adaptive Context Optimization strategy that distills expert knowledge, coupled with a Chain-of-Adjudication mechanism to enforce active evidentiary inquiry. Furthermore, addressing the inadequacy of sparse binary feedback for complex liability assessment, we implement a novel Ordinal-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning mechanism that calibrates decision boundaries against hierarchical severity. Extensive experiments show that our RideJudge-8B achieves 88.41\% accuracy, surpassing 32B-scale baselines and establishing a new standard for interpretable adjudication.

AI.tldr: RideJudge是一个用于网约车责任判定的渐进式视觉-逻辑对齐框架，通过合成轨迹、自适应上下文优化和链式裁决机制，解决了多模态LLM在责任判定中的语义鸿沟和逻辑松散问题，在8B参数规模下达到88.41%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 网约车责任判定面临三大挑战：1）海量案件使人工审核不可行；2）传统自动化方法缺乏推理透明度；3）多模态LLM存在感知幻觉和逻辑松散问题，无法满足准司法决策的严谨证据要求。
AI.method: 提出RideJudge渐进式视觉-逻辑对齐框架：1）SynTraj合成引擎将抽象责任概念转化为具体轨迹模式；2）自适应上下文优化策略提炼专家知识；3）链式裁决机制强制主动证据查询；4）序数敏感强化学习根据责任严重程度校准决策边界。
AI.result: RideJudge-8B模型达到88.41%的准确率，超越了32B规模的基线模型，为可解释的责任判定设立了新标准。
AI.conclusion: RideJudge通过弥合视觉语义与严谨证据协议之间的鸿沟，解决了多模态LLM在责任判定中的系统性错位问题，实现了高效、透明且准确的责任裁决。

title: Omni IIE Bench: Benchmarking the Practical Capabilities of Image Editing Models
summary: While Instruction-based Image Editing (IIE) has achieved significant progress, existing benchmarks pursue task breadth via mixed evaluations. This paradigm obscures a critical failure mode crucial in professional applications: the inconsistent performance of models across tasks of varying semantic scales. To address this gap, we introduce Omni IIE Bench, a high-quality, human-annotated benchmark specifically designed to diagnose the editing consistency of IIE models in practical application scenarios. Omni IIE Bench features an innovative dual-track diagnostic design: (1) Single-turn Consistency, comprising shared-context task pairs of attribute modification and entity replacement; and (2) Multi-turn Coordination, involving continuous dialogue tasks that traverse semantic scales. The benchmark is constructed via an exceptionally rigorous multi-stage human filtering process, incorporating a quality standard enforced by computer vision graduate students and an industry relevance review conducted by professional designers. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of 8 mainstream IIE models using Omni IIE Bench. Our analysis quantifies, for the first time, a prevalent performance gap: nearly all models exhibit a significant performance degradation when transitioning from low-semantic-scale to high-semantic-scale tasks. Omni IIE Bench provides critical diagnostic tools and insights for the development of next-generation, more reliable, and stable IIE models.

AI.tldr: Omni IIE Bench是一个专门用于诊断指令式图像编辑模型在跨语义尺度任务中一致性的高质量人工标注基准，通过双轨诊断设计揭示模型在不同语义尺度任务间的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 现有指令式图像编辑基准通过混合评估追求任务广度，但忽视了专业应用中一个关键失败模式：模型在不同语义尺度任务上的不一致性能表现，这在实际应用场景中至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了Omni IIE Bench基准，采用创新的双轨诊断设计：(1)单轮一致性：包含共享上下文的属性修改和实体替换任务对；(2)多轮协调：涉及跨语义尺度的连续对话任务。基准通过严格的多阶段人工筛选流程构建，包括计算机视觉研究生执行的质量标准和专业设计师进行的行业相关性审查。
AI.result: 对8个主流IIE模型进行全面评估，首次量化了一个普遍存在的性能差距：几乎所有模型在从低语义尺度任务过渡到高语义尺度任务时都表现出显著的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: Omni IIE Bench为开发下一代更可靠、更稳定的指令式图像编辑模型提供了关键的诊断工具和见解，有助于解决模型在不同语义尺度任务间的不一致性问题。

title: Towards Safer Large Reasoning Models by Promoting Safety Decision-Making before Chain-of-Thought Generation
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieved remarkable performance via chain-of-thought (CoT), but recent studies showed that such enhanced reasoning capabilities are at the expense of significantly degraded safety capabilities. In this paper, we reveal that LRMs' safety degradation occurs only after CoT is enabled, and this degradation is not observed when CoT is disabled. This observation motivates us to consider encouraging LRMs to make safety decisions before CoT generation. To this end, we propose a novel safety alignment method that promotes the safety decision-making of LRMs before starting CoT generation. Specifically, we first utilize a Bert-based classifier to extract safety decision signals from a safe model (e.g., a CoT-disabled LRM) and then integrate these signals into LRMs' safety alignment as auxiliary supervision. In this way, the safety gradients can be backpropagated to the LRMs' latent representations, effectively strengthening the LRMs' safety decision-making abilities against CoT generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method substantially improves the safety capabilities of LRMs while effectively maintaining LRMs' general reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型推理模型在启用思维链时安全性显著下降，提出在思维链生成前加强安全决策的新对齐方法
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型通过思维链获得了强大的推理能力，但研究发现这种增强是以安全性显著下降为代价的。作者观察到安全性下降只在启用思维链时发生，而在禁用思维链时不会出现，这促使他们考虑在思维链生成前加强模型的安全决策能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的安全对齐方法，促进大型推理模型在开始思维链生成前进行安全决策。具体方法包括：1）使用基于Bert的分类器从安全模型（如禁用思维链的大型推理模型）中提取安全决策信号；2）将这些信号作为辅助监督集成到大型推理模型的安全对齐中。通过这种方式，安全梯度可以反向传播到模型的潜在表示中，有效增强模型在思维链生成前的安全决策能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法显著提高了大型推理模型的安全能力，同时有效保持了模型的一般推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过在思维链生成前加强安全决策，可以有效解决大型推理模型在启用思维链时安全性下降的问题，实现安全性和推理能力的平衡。

title: From Digital Twins to World Models:Opportunities, Challenges, and Applications for Mobile Edge General Intelligence
summary: The rapid evolution toward 6G and beyond communication systems is accelerating the convergence of digital twins and world models at the network edge. Traditional digital twins provide high-fidelity representations of physical systems and support monitoring, analysis, and offline optimization. However, in highly dynamic edge environments, they face limitations in autonomy, adaptability, and scalability. This paper presents a systematic survey of the transition from digital twins to world models and discusses its role in enabling edge general intelligence (EGI). First, the paper clarifies the conceptual differences between digital twins and world models and highlights the shift from physics-based, centralized, and system-centric replicas to data-driven, decentralized, and agent-centric internal models. This discussion helps readers gain a clear understanding of how this transition enables more adaptive, autonomous, and resource-efficient intelligence at the network edge. The paper reviews the design principles, architectures, and key components of world models, including perception, latent state representation, dynamics learning, imagination-based planning, and memory. In addition, it examines the integration of world models and digital twins in wireless EGI systems and surveys emerging applications in integrated sensing and communications, semantic communication, air-ground networks, and low-altitude wireless networks. Finally, this survey provides a systematic roadmap and practical insights for designing world-model-driven edge intelligence systems in wireless and edge computing environments. It also outlines key research challenges and future directions toward scalable, reliable, and interoperable world models for edge-native agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了从数字孪生向世界模型的转变及其在边缘通用智能中的作用，分析了概念差异、设计原则、架构组件，并探讨了在无线边缘智能系统中的集成应用。
AI.motivation: 随着6G及未来通信系统的发展，数字孪生与世界模型在网络边缘加速融合。传统数字孪生在高度动态的边缘环境中面临自主性、适应性和可扩展性限制，需要向更智能的世界模型过渡以支持边缘通用智能。
AI.method: 通过系统综述方法，首先澄清数字孪生与世界模型的概念差异，分析从物理驱动、集中式、系统中心化向数据驱动、去中心化、智能体中心化的转变。然后回顾世界模型的设计原则、架构和关键组件，包括感知、潜在状态表示、动态学习、基于想象的规划和记忆机制。
AI.result: 论文探讨了世界模型与数字孪生在无线边缘智能系统中的集成，并调查了在集成感知与通信、语义通信、空地网络和低空无线网络等新兴应用。提供了设计世界模型驱动的边缘智能系统的系统路线图和实用见解。
AI.conclusion: 本文为在无线和边缘计算环境中设计世界模型驱动的边缘智能系统提供了系统框架，并指出了实现可扩展、可靠和可互操作的世界模型以支持边缘原生智能体AI的关键研究挑战和未来方向。

title: EmergeNav: Structured Embodied Inference for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
summary: Zero-shot vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE) remains challenging for modern vision-language models (VLMs). Although these models encode useful semantic priors, their open-ended reasoning does not directly translate into stable long-horizon embodied execution. We argue that the key bottleneck is not missing knowledge alone, but missing an execution structure for organizing instruction following, perceptual grounding, temporal progress, and stage verification. We propose EmergeNav, a zero-shot framework that formulates continuous VLN as structured embodied inference. EmergeNav combines a Plan--Solve--Transition hierarchy for stage-structured execution, GIPE for goal-conditioned perceptual extraction, contrastive dual-memory reasoning for progress grounding, and role-separated Dual-FOV sensing for time-aligned local control and boundary verification. On VLN-CE, EmergeNav achieves strong zero-shot performance using only open-source VLM backbones and no task-specific training, explicit maps, graph search, or waypoint predictors, reaching 30.00 SR with Qwen3-VL-8B and 37.00 SR with Qwen3-VL-32B. These results suggest that explicit execution structure is a key ingredient for turning VLM priors into stable embodied navigation behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EmergeNav框架，通过结构化执行层次将视觉语言模型先验知识转化为稳定的零样本连续环境视觉语言导航能力，无需任务特定训练或显式地图。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型虽然编码了有用的语义先验，但其开放式推理无法直接转化为稳定的长时程具身执行。主要瓶颈不是缺少知识，而是缺少组织指令跟随、感知接地、时间进度和阶段验证的执行结构。
AI.method: 提出EmergeNav零样本框架，将连续VLN建模为结构化具身推理：1) Plan-Solve-Transition层次结构进行阶段化执行；2) GIPE进行目标条件感知提取；3) 对比双记忆推理进行进度接地；4) 角色分离的双FOV感知进行时间对齐的局部控制和边界验证。
AI.result: 在VLN-CE上，仅使用开源VLM骨干网络且无需任务特定训练、显式地图、图搜索或路径点预测器，EmergeNav取得了强零样本性能：Qwen3-VL-8B达到30.00 SR，Qwen3-VL-32B达到37.00 SR。
AI.conclusion: 明确的执行结构是将VLM先验知识转化为稳定具身导航行为的关键要素，结构化推理框架能够有效弥补开放式推理在长时程执行中的不足。

title: From Words to Worlds: Benchmarking Cross-Cultural Cultural Understanding in Machine Translation
summary: Culture-expressions, such as idioms, slang, and culture-specific items (CSIs), are pervasive in natural language and encode meanings that go beyond literal linguistic form. Accurately translating such expressions remains challenging for machine translation systems. Despite this, existing benchmarks remain fragmented and do not provide a systematic framework for evaluating translation performance on culture-loaded expressions. To address this gap, we introduce CulT-Eval, a benchmark designed to evaluate how models handle different types of culturally grounded expressions. CulT-Eval comprises over 7,959 carefully curated instances spanning multiple types of culturally grounded expressions, with a comprehensive error taxonomy covering culturally grounded expressions. Through extensive evaluation of large language models and detailed analysis, we identify recurring and systematic failure modes that are not adequately captured by existing automatic metrics. Accordingly, we propose a complementary evaluation metric that targets culturally induced meaning deviations overlooked by standard MT metrics. The results indicate that current models struggle to preserve culturally grounded meaning and to capture the cultural and contextual nuances essential for accurate translation. Our benchmark and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CulT-Eval-E75D/.

AI.tldr: CulT-Eval是一个包含7959个实例的基准测试，用于评估机器翻译系统处理文化表达（如成语、俚语、文化特定项目）的能力，揭示了现有模型在文化含义保留方面的系统性问题。
AI.motivation: 文化表达（如成语、俚语、文化特定项目）在自然语言中普遍存在，其含义超越字面形式。准确翻译这些表达对机器翻译系统具有挑战性，但现有基准测试分散且缺乏系统评估框架。
AI.method: 引入CulT-Eval基准测试，包含7959个精心策划的实例，涵盖多种文化表达类型，并建立了全面的错误分类体系。通过大规模语言模型评估和详细分析，识别系统性的失败模式。
AI.result: 当前模型在保留文化基础含义和捕捉文化及上下文细微差别方面存在困难，标准机器翻译指标无法充分捕捉文化引起的意义偏差。提出了针对文化诱导意义偏差的补充评估指标。
AI.conclusion: CulT-Eval基准测试填补了文化表达翻译评估的空白，揭示了现有模型的局限性，并提供了针对文化意义偏差的评估方法，有助于改进机器翻译系统处理文化内容的能力。

title: When Only the Final Text Survives: Implicit Execution Tracing for Multi-Agent Attribution
summary: When a multi-agent system produces an incorrect or harmful answer, who is accountable if execution logs and agent identifiers are unavailable? Multi-agent language systems increasingly rely on structured interactions such as delegation and iterative refinement, yet the final output often obscures the underlying interaction topology and agent contributions. We introduce IET (Implicit Execution Tracing), a metadata-independent framework that enables token-level attribution directly from generated text and a simple mechanism for interaction topology reconstruction. During generation, agent-specific keyed signals are embedded into the token distribution, transforming the text into a self-describing execution trace detectable only with a secret key. At detection time, a transition-aware scoring method identifies agent handover points and reconstructs the interaction graph. Experiments show that IET recovers agent segments and coordination structure with high accuracy while preserving generation quality, enabling privacy-preserving auditing for multi-agent language systems.

AI.tldr: IET框架通过嵌入密钥信号实现多智能体语言系统的令牌级归因和交互拓扑重建，无需执行日志即可进行隐私保护审计
AI.motivation: 当多智能体系统产生错误或有害答案时，如果没有执行日志和智能体标识符，难以确定责任归属。当前多智能体语言系统依赖结构化交互（如委托和迭代优化），但最终输出往往掩盖了底层交互拓扑和智能体贡献。
AI.method: 引入IET（隐式执行追踪）框架，在生成过程中将智能体特定的密钥信号嵌入令牌分布中，将文本转换为自描述的执行轨迹（仅通过密钥可检测）。在检测阶段，使用转移感知的评分方法识别智能体交接点并重建交互图。
AI.result: 实验表明，IET能够以高准确率恢复智能体片段和协调结构，同时保持生成质量，实现了多智能体语言系统的隐私保护审计能力。
AI.conclusion: IET框架通过隐式执行追踪解决了多智能体系统责任归属问题，提供了一种无需执行日志即可进行令牌级归因和交互拓扑重建的隐私保护审计方案。

title: Behavior-Centric Extraction of Scenarios from Highway Traffic Data and their Domain-Knowledge-Guided Clustering using CVQ-VAE
comment: Accepted as a conference paper in IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV) 2026, Detroit, MI, United States
summary: Approval of ADS depends on evaluating its behavior within representative real-world traffic scenarios. A common way to obtain such scenarios is to extract them from real-world data recordings. These can then be grouped and serve as basis on which the ADS is subsequently tested. This poses two central challenges: how scenarios are extracted and how they are grouped. Existing extraction methods rely on heterogeneous definitions, hindering scenario comparability. For the grouping of scenarios, rule-based or ML-based methods can be utilized. However, while modern ML-based approaches can handle the complexity of traffic scenarios, unlike rule-based approaches, they lack interpretability and may not align with domain-knowledge. This work contributes to a standardized scenario extraction based on the Scenario-as-Specification concept, as well as a domain-knowledge-guided scenario clustering process. Experiments on the highD dataset demonstrate that scenarios can be extracted reliably and that domain-knowledge can be effectively integrated into the clustering process. As a result, the proposed methodology supports a more standardized process for deriving scenario categories from highway data recordings and thus enables a more efficient validation process of automated vehicles.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于"场景即规范"概念的标准化场景提取方法，以及结合领域知识的场景聚类流程，用于从高速公路数据记录中更有效地提取和分组测试自动驾驶系统的交通场景。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统的批准需要评估其在真实交通场景中的行为。现有方法存在两个主要问题：场景提取缺乏标准化定义导致可比性差；场景聚类方法中，基于规则的方法可解释但处理复杂场景能力有限，而基于机器学习的方法能处理复杂性但缺乏可解释性且难以融入领域知识。
AI.method: 1. 基于"场景即规范"概念建立标准化场景提取流程；2. 开发领域知识引导的场景聚类过程，将领域专业知识有效整合到聚类算法中；3. 在高D数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验证明：1. 场景可以被可靠地提取；2. 领域知识可以有效地整合到聚类过程中；3. 该方法支持从高速公路数据记录中推导场景类别的标准化流程。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法支持从高速公路数据记录中推导场景类别的更标准化流程，从而实现了自动驾驶车辆更高效的验证过程。

title: Ruyi2.5 Technical Report
summary: We present Ruyi2.5, a multimodal familial model built on the AI Flow framework. Extending Ruyi2's "Train Once, Deploy Many" paradigm to the multimodal domain, Ruyi2.5 constructs a shared-backbone architecture that co-trains models of varying scales within a single unified pipeline, ensuring semantic consistency across all deployment tiers. Built upon Ruyi2.5, Ruyi2.5-Camera model is developed as a privacy-preserving camera service system, which instantiates Ruyi2.5-Camera into a two-stage recognition pipeline: an edge model applies information-bottleneck-guided irreversible feature mapping to de-identify raw frames at the source, while a cloud model performs deep behavior reasoning. To accelerate reinforcement learning fine-tuning, we further propose Binary Prefix Policy Optimization (BPPO), which reduces sample redundancy via binary response selection and focuses gradient updates on response prefixes, achieving a 2 to 3 times training speedup over GRPO. Experiments show Ruyi2.5 matches Qwen3-VL on the general multimodal benchmarks, while Ruyi2.5-Camera substantially outperforms Qwen3-VL on privacy-constrained surveillance tasks.

AI.tldr: Ruyi2.5是一个基于AI Flow框架的多模态家族模型，扩展了"一次训练，多次部署"范式到多模态领域。基于此开发的Ruyi2.5-Camera是一个隐私保护摄像头服务系统，采用两阶段识别管道。同时提出了BPPO方法加速强化学习微调。
AI.motivation: 将Ruyi2的"一次训练，多次部署"范式扩展到多模态领域，构建语义一致的多尺度模型家族。同时解决隐私保护摄像头系统中的身份识别与行为分析问题，并优化强化学习微调效率。
AI.method: 1. 采用共享骨干架构，在统一管道中协同训练不同规模的模型；2. 构建两阶段识别管道：边缘模型使用信息瓶颈引导的不可逆特征映射进行去识别化，云端模型进行深度行为推理；3. 提出BPPO方法，通过二进制响应选择减少样本冗余，聚焦响应前缀的梯度更新。
AI.result: 1. Ruyi2.5在通用多模态基准测试中与Qwen3-VL表现相当；2. Ruyi2.5-Camera在隐私约束的监控任务中显著优于Qwen3-VL；3. BPPO相比GRPO实现了2-3倍的训练加速。
AI.conclusion: Ruyi2.5成功将"一次训练，多次部署"范式扩展到多模态领域，构建了语义一致的多尺度模型家族。Ruyi2.5-Camera系统有效解决了隐私保护摄像头服务的需求，BPPO方法显著提升了强化学习微调效率。

title: Informative Semi-Factuals for XAI: The Elaborated Explanations that People Prefer
summary: Recently, in eXplainable AI (XAI), $\textit{even if}$ explanations -- so-called semi-factuals -- have emerged as a popular strategy that explains how a predicted outcome $\textit{can remain the same}$ even when certain input-features are altered. For example, in the commonly-used banking app scenario, a semi-factual explanation could inform customers about better options, other alternatives for their successful application, by saying "$\textit{Even if}$ you asked for double the loan amount, you would still be accepted". Most semi-factuals XAI algorithms focus on finding maximal value-changes to a single key-feature that do $\textit{not}$ alter the outcome (unlike counterfactual explanations that often find minimal value-changes to several features that alter the outcome). However, no current semi-factual method explains $\textit{why}$ these extreme value-changes do not alter outcomes; for example, a more informative semi-factual could tell the customer that it is their good credit score that allows them to borrow double their requested loan. In this work, we advance a new algorithm -- the $\textit{informative semi-factuals}$ (ISF) method -- that generates more elaborated explanations supplementing semi-factuals with information about additional $\textit{hidden features}$ that influence an automated decision. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that this ISF method computes semi-factuals that are both informative and of high-quality on key metrics. Furthermore, a user study shows that people prefer these elaborated explanations over the simpler semi-factual explanations generated by current methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的可解释AI方法——信息性半事实解释(ISF)，它不仅生成半事实解释（说明即使某些特征改变，预测结果仍保持不变），还补充了影响决策的隐藏特征信息，使解释更加丰富和有用。
AI.motivation: 当前半事实解释方法存在局限性：虽然能说明即使某些输入特征发生极端变化，预测结果仍保持不变，但无法解释为什么这些极端变化不会改变结果。这使得半事实解释缺乏足够的信息价值，无法为用户提供更深层次的洞察。
AI.method: 提出信息性半事实解释(ISF)算法，该算法不仅生成传统的半事实解释（说明即使某些特征值发生极端变化，结果仍保持不变），还补充了影响自动化决策的隐藏特征信息。ISF方法通过识别和解释那些在决策过程中起关键作用但未被直接提及的特征，使解释更加丰富和全面。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的实验结果表明，ISF方法生成的半事实解释在关键指标上既具有信息性又具有高质量。用户研究进一步显示，人们更喜欢这种经过详细阐述的解释，而不是当前方法生成的简单半事实解释。
AI.conclusion: 信息性半事实解释(ISF)方法通过补充隐藏特征信息，显著提升了半事实解释的质量和实用性，为用户提供了更丰富、更有洞察力的解释，有助于增强AI系统的透明度和可信度。

title: Grid Spatial Understanding: A Dataset for Textual Spatial Reasoning over Grids, Embodied Settings, and Coordinate Structures
summary: We introduce GSU, a text-only grid dataset to evaluate the spatial reasoning capabilities of LLMs over 3 core tasks: navigation, object localization, and structure composition. By forgoing visual inputs, isolating spatial reasoning from perception, we show that while most models grasp basic grid concepts, they struggle with frames of reference relative to an embodied agent and identifying 3D shapes from coordinate lists. We also find that exposure to a visual modality does not provide a generalizable understanding of 3D space that VLMs are able to utilize for these tasks. Finally, we show that while the very latest frontier models can solve the provided tasks (though harder variants may still stump them), fully fine-tuning a small LM or LORA fine-tuning a small LLM show potential to match frontier model performance, suggesting an avenue for specialized embodied agents.

AI.tldr: GSU是一个纯文本网格数据集，用于评估LLM在导航、物体定位和结构组合三个核心任务中的空间推理能力，发现模型在相对参考系和3D形状识别方面存在困难，视觉模态暴露不能提供可泛化的3D空间理解，但微调小型模型可以匹配前沿模型性能。
AI.motivation: 评估大型语言模型在空间推理方面的能力，特别是通过纯文本方式隔离空间推理与感知能力，研究模型在3D空间理解方面的局限性以及视觉模态对空间推理的影响。
AI.method: 创建GSU纯文本网格数据集，包含导航、物体定位和结构组合三个核心任务。通过排除视觉输入来隔离空间推理与感知，评估不同模型在这些任务上的表现，包括前沿模型、小型语言模型以及经过微调的模型。
AI.result: 大多数模型能理解基本网格概念，但在相对参考系（相对于具身智能体）和从坐标列表识别3D形状方面存在困难。视觉模态暴露不能为视觉语言模型提供可泛化的3D空间理解。最新前沿模型能解决这些任务，但更难的变体仍具挑战性。完全微调小型语言模型或使用LORA微调小型LLM有潜力匹配前沿模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 纯文本空间推理评估揭示了LLM在3D空间理解方面的局限性，特别是相对参考系和3D形状识别。视觉模态不能提供可转移的空间推理能力。通过微调小型模型可以开发专门化的具身智能体，为资源受限环境提供了有前景的途径。

title: Per-Domain Generalizing Policies: On Learning Efficient and Robust Q-Value Functions (Extended Version with Technical Appendix)
summary: Learning per-domain generalizing policies is a key challenge in learning for planning. Standard approaches learn state-value functions represented as graph neural networks using supervised learning on optimal plans generated by a teacher planner. In this work, we advocate for learning Q-value functions instead. Such policies are drastically cheaper to evaluate for a given state, as they need to process only the current state rather than every successor. Surprisingly, vanilla supervised learning of Q-values performs poorly as it does not learn to distinguish between the actions taken and those not taken by the teacher. We address this by using regularization terms that enforce this distinction, resulting in Q-value policies that consistently outperform state-value policies across a range of 10 domains and are competitive with the planner LAMA-first.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出学习Q值函数而非状态值函数来提升规划学习中的跨域泛化策略，通过正则化项区分教师规划器采取与未采取的动作，显著降低策略评估成本并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 学习跨域泛化策略是规划学习的关键挑战。传统方法使用图神经网络学习状态值函数，通过监督学习在教师规划器生成的最优计划上进行训练。但这种方法在评估给定状态时成本较高，需要处理所有后继状态而非仅当前状态。
AI.method: 提出学习Q值函数而非状态值函数，使用正则化项来区分教师规划器采取的动作与未采取的动作。这种方法只需处理当前状态而非所有后继状态，大幅降低了策略评估的计算成本。
AI.result: Q值策略在10个不同领域中始终优于状态值策略，并且与规划器LAMA-first具有竞争力。正则化方法有效解决了传统监督学习Q值时无法区分教师采取与未采取动作的问题。
AI.conclusion: 学习Q值函数是比状态值函数更有效的跨域泛化策略学习方法，通过适当的正则化可以显著提升性能并降低计算成本，在多个领域展现出优越性。

title: MSRAMIE: Multimodal Structured Reasoning Agent for Multi-instruction Image Editing
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables, appendix and references provided
summary: Existing instruction-based image editing models perform well with simple, single-step instructions but degrade in realistic scenarios that involve multiple, lengthy, and interdependent directives. A main cause is the scarcity of training data with complex multi-instruction annotations. However, it is costly to collect such data and retrain these models. To address this challenge, we propose MSRAMIE, a training-free agent framework built on Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM). MSRAMIE takes existing editing models as plug-in components and handle multi-instruction tasks via structured multimodal reasoning.
