Our regularization enables explicit controllability of the trade-off between creativity and consistency.

AI.tldr: FrescoDiffusion：一种无需训练的方法，用于从单个复杂图像生成连贯的大格式图像到视频，通过结合分块去噪和预计算的潜在先验来解决4K超高清分辨率下的全局一致性难题。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的图像到视频模型在处理超高清分辨率输入（如4K）时面临挑战：原生分辨率生成会丢失细粒度结构，而高分辨率分块去噪虽保留局部细节但破坏了全局布局一致性。这在壁画动画场景中尤为严重，因为壁画包含许多不同角色、物体和语义不同的子场景，需要在时间上保持空间连贯性。
AI.method: FrescoDiffusion是一种无需训练的方法，核心思想是在分块去噪基础上增加预计算的潜在先验：首先生成低分辨率视频，上采样其潜在轨迹以获得捕捉长程时空结构的全局参考。对于4K生成，计算每个分块的噪声预测，并通过最小化模型输出空间中的加权最小二乘目标，在每一步扩散时间步将其与参考融合。该方法还提供空间正则化变量，实现对运动区域的区域级控制。
AI.result: 在VBench-I2V数据集和提出的壁画I2V数据集上的实验显示，相比分块基线方法，FrescoDiffusion在全局一致性和保真度方面都有改进，同时计算效率高。正则化方法使得在创造性和一致性之间的权衡具有明确的可控性。
AI.conclusion: FrescoDiffusion通过结合分块去噪和预计算的潜在先验，有效解决了大格式图像到视频生成中的全局一致性问题，特别适用于壁画动画等复杂场景，在保持局部细节的同时增强了时空连贯性。

title: ECHO: Towards Emotionally Appropriate and Contextually Aware Interactive Head Generation
summary: In natural face-to-face interaction, participants seamlessly alternate between speaking and listening, producing facial behaviors (FBs) that are finely informed by long-range context and naturally exhibit contextual appropriateness and emotional rationality. Interactive Head Generation (IHG) aims to synthesize lifelike avatar head video emulating such capabilities. Existing IHG methods typically condition on dual-track signals (i.e., human user's behaviors and pre-defined audio for avatar) within a short temporal window, jointly driving generation of avatar's audio-aligned lip articulation and non-verbal FBs. However, two main challenges persist in these methods: (i) the reliance on short-clip behavioral cues without long-range contextual modeling leads them to produce facial behaviors lacking contextual appropriateness; and (ii) the entangled, role-agnostic fusion of dual-track signals empirically introduces cross-signal interference, potentially compromising lip-region synchronization during speaking. To this end, we propose ECHO, a novel IHG framework comprising two key components: a Long-range Contextual Understanding (LCU) component that facilitates contextual understanding of both behavior-grounded dynamics and linguistic-driven affective semantics to promote contextual appropriateness and emotional rationality of synthesized avatar FBs; and a block-wise Spatial-aware Decoupled Cross-attention Modulation (SDCM) module, that preserves self-audio-driven lip articulation while adaptively integrating user contextual behavioral cues for non-lip facial regions, complemented by our designed two-stage training paradigm, to jointly enhance lip synchronization and visual fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed components and ECHO's superior IHG performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ECHO框架，通过长程上下文理解和空间感知解耦交叉注意力机制，解决交互式头部生成中上下文适当性和唇部同步问题。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式头部生成方法存在两个主要问题：1) 依赖短片段行为线索，缺乏长程上下文建模，导致生成的面部行为缺乏上下文适当性；2) 双轨信号（用户行为和预定义音频）的角色无关融合导致交叉信号干扰，可能损害说话时的唇部区域同步。
AI.method: 提出ECHO框架，包含两个关键组件：1) 长程上下文理解组件，促进对行为基础动态和语言驱动情感语义的上下文理解；2) 块级空间感知解耦交叉注意力模块，在保持自音频驱动唇部发音的同时，自适应整合用户上下文行为线索用于非唇部面部区域，配合两阶段训练范式。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了所提出组件的有效性，以及ECHO在交互式头部生成任务上的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: ECHO框架通过长程上下文建模和空间感知解耦机制，显著提升了交互式头部生成中面部行为的上下文适当性、情感合理性以及唇部同步质量。

title: Edit-As-Act: Goal-Regressive Planning for Open-Vocabulary 3D Indoor Scene Editing
summary: Editing a 3D indoor scene from natural language is conceptually straightforward but technically challenging. Existing open-vocabulary systems often regenerate large portions of a scene or rely on image-space edits that disrupt spatial structure, resulting in unintended global changes or physically inconsistent layouts. These limitations stem from treating editing primarily as a generative task. We take a different view. A user instruction defines a desired world state, and editing should be the minimal sequence of actions that makes this state true while preserving everything else. This perspective motivates Edit-As-Act, a framework that performs open-vocabulary scene editing as goal-regressive planning in 3D space. Given a source scene and free-form instruction, Edit-As-Act predicts symbolic goal predicates and plans in EditLang, a PDDL-inspired action language that we design with explicit preconditions and effects encoding support, contact, collision, and other geometric relations. A language-driven planner proposes actions, and a validator enforces goal-directedness, monotonicity, and physical feasibility, producing interpretable and physically coherent transformations. By separating reasoning from low-level generation, Edit-As-Act achieves instruction fidelity, semantic consistency, and physical plausibility - three criteria that existing paradigms cannot satisfy together. On E2A-Bench, our benchmark of 63 editing tasks across 9 indoor environments, Edit-As-Act significantly outperforms prior approaches across all edit types and scene categories.

AI.tldr: Edit-As-Act框架将自然语言3D室内场景编辑视为目标回归规划问题，通过符号化目标谓词和PDDL风格的动作语言实现物理一致的场景变换，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇系统在3D室内场景编辑中存在两大问题：要么重新生成场景大部分内容，要么依赖图像空间编辑破坏空间结构，导致意外全局变化或物理不一致布局。这些限制源于将编辑主要视为生成任务，而作者认为编辑应该是实现用户指令所需的最小动作序列。
AI.method: 提出Edit-As-Act框架，将开放词汇场景编辑视为3D空间中的目标回归规划。给定源场景和自由形式指令，系统预测符号化目标谓词，并在EditLang（受PDDL启发的动作语言）中进行规划，该语言具有明确的前置条件和效果，编码支持、接触、碰撞等几何关系。语言驱动规划器提出动作，验证器强制执行目标导向性、单调性和物理可行性。
AI.result: 在E2A-Bench基准测试中（包含9个室内环境的63个编辑任务），Edit-As-Act在所有编辑类型和场景类别上显著优于先前方法。通过分离推理与低级生成，实现了指令保真度、语义一致性和物理合理性这三个现有范式无法同时满足的标准。
AI.conclusion: Edit-As-Act框架通过将3D场景编辑重新定义为目标回归规划问题，解决了现有方法的局限性。该方法产生可解释且物理一致的变换，在开放词汇场景编辑中实现了更好的指令遵循、语义保持和物理合理性。

title: Anchoring and Rescaling Attention for Semantically Coherent Inbetweening
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026; Code is released at https://github.com/teunchoi/TGI
summary: Generative inbetweening (GI) seeks to synthesize realistic intermediate frames between the first and last keyframes beyond mere interpolation. As sequences become sparser and motions larger, previous GI models struggle with inconsistent frames with unstable pacing and semantic misalignment. Since GI involves fixed endpoints and numerous plausible paths, this task requires additional guidance gained from the keyframes and text to specify the intended path. Thus, we give semantic and temporal guidance from the keyframes and text onto each intermediate frame through Keyframe-anchored Attention Bias. We also better enforce frame consistency with Rescaled Temporal RoPE, which allows self-attention to attend to keyframes more faithfully. TGI-Bench, the first benchmark specifically designed for text-conditioned GI evaluation, enables challenge-targeted evaluation to analyze GI models. Without additional training, our method achieves state-of-the-art frame consistency, semantic fidelity, and pace stability for both short and long sequences across diverse challenges.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的生成式中间帧合成方法，通过关键帧锚定注意力偏置和重缩放时间RoPE技术，在保持帧一致性和语义对齐的同时，提升了长序列和大运动场景下的中间帧生成质量。
AI.motivation: 生成式中间帧合成任务在序列稀疏和运动幅度大的情况下，现有模型存在帧不一致、节奏不稳定和语义错位的问题。由于中间帧生成有多个合理路径，需要从关键帧和文本中获取额外指导来指定预期路径。
AI.method: 提出了关键帧锚定注意力偏置技术，从关键帧和文本中提取语义和时间指导到每个中间帧；使用重缩放时间RoPE技术，使自注意力机制能更忠实地关注关键帧，从而增强帧一致性。
AI.result: 无需额外训练，该方法在短序列和长序列的各种挑战场景下，在帧一致性、语义保真度和节奏稳定性方面都达到了最先进的性能。同时创建了首个专门用于文本条件中间帧合成评估的基准TGI-Bench。
AI.conclusion: 通过关键帧锚定注意力偏置和重缩放时间RoPE的组合，有效解决了生成式中间帧合成中的帧不一致和语义错位问题，为稀疏序列和大运动场景提供了高质量的中间帧生成解决方案。

title: FACE-net: Factual Calibration and Emotion Augmentation for Retrieval-enhanced Emotional Video Captioning
summary: Emotional Video Captioning (EVC) is an emerging task, which aims to describe factual content with the intrinsic emotions expressed in videos. Existing works perceive global emotional cues and then combine with video content to generate descriptions. However, insufficient factual and emotional cues mining and coordination during generation make their methods difficult to deal with the factual-emotional bias, which refers to the factual and emotional requirements being different in different samples on generation. To this end, we propose a retrieval-enhanced framework with FActual Calibration and Emotion augmentation (FACE-net), which through a unified architecture collaboratively mines factual-emotional semantics and provides adaptive and accurate guidance for generation, breaking through the compromising tendency of factual-emotional descriptions in all sample learning. Technically, we firstly introduces an external repository and retrieves the most relevant sentences with the video content to augment the semantic information. Subsequently, our factual calibration via uncertainty estimation module splits the retrieved information into subject-predicate-object triplets, and self-refines and cross-refines different components through video content to effectively mine the factual semantics; while our progressive visual emotion augmentation module leverages the calibrated factual semantics as experts, interacts with the video content and emotion dictionary to generate visual queries and candidate emotions, and then aggregates them to adaptively augment emotions to each factual semantics. Moreover, to alleviate the factual-emotional bias, we design a dynamic bias adjustment routing module to predict and adjust the degree of bias of a sample.

AI.tldr: FACE-net是一个检索增强的情感视频描述框架，通过事实校准和情感增强解决事实-情感偏置问题，使用统一架构协同挖掘事实-情感语义并提供自适应生成指导。
AI.motivation: 现有情感视频描述方法在感知全局情感线索后与视频内容结合生成描述，但存在事实和情感线索挖掘与协调不足的问题，难以处理不同样本在生成时事实和情感需求不同的"事实-情感偏置"问题。
AI.method: 提出FACE-net框架：1)引入外部知识库检索相关句子增强语义信息；2)通过不确定性估计的事实校准模块将检索信息分解为主谓宾三元组，通过视频内容进行自精炼和交叉精炼挖掘事实语义；3)渐进式视觉情感增强模块利用校准的事实语义作为专家，与视频内容和情感词典交互生成视觉查询和候选情感，聚合后自适应增强每个事实语义的情感；4)动态偏置调整路由模块预测和调整样本的偏置程度。
AI.result: 该方法突破了所有样本学习中事实-情感描述的妥协倾向，能够更有效地挖掘事实-情感语义并提供自适应、准确的生成指导。
AI.conclusion: FACE-net通过检索增强、事实校准、情感增强和动态偏置调整的协同设计，有效解决了情感视频描述中的事实-情感偏置问题，实现了更准确、自适应的视频描述生成。

title: AR-CoPO: Align Autoregressive Video Generation with Contrastive Policy Optimization
summary: Streaming autoregressive (AR) video generators combined with few-step distillation achieve low-latency, high-quality synthesis, yet remain difficult to align via reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). Existing SDE-based GRPO methods face challenges in this setting: few-step ODEs and consistency model samplers deviate from standard flow-matching ODEs, and their short, low-stochasticity trajectories are highly sensitive to initialization noise, rendering intermediate SDE exploration ineffective. We propose AR-CoPO (AutoRegressive Contrastive Policy Optimization), a framework that adapts the Neighbor GRPO contrastive perspective to streaming AR generation. AR-CoPO introduces chunk-level alignment via a forking mechanism that constructs neighborhood candidates at a randomly selected chunk, assigns sequence-level rewards, and performs localized GRPO updates. We further propose a semi-on-policy training strategy that complements on-policy exploration with exploitation over a replay buffer of reference rollouts, improving generation quality across domains. Experiments on Self-Forcing demonstrate that AR-CoPO improves both out-of-domain generalization and in-domain human preference alignment over the baseline, providing evidence of genuine alignment rather than reward hacking.

AI.tldr: AR-CoPO：针对流式自回归视频生成器的强化学习对齐框架，通过分块级对齐机制和半在线策略训练，解决了现有方法在少步采样和低随机性轨迹中的对齐难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于SDE的GRPO方法在流式自回归视频生成器上存在对齐困难：少步ODE和一致性模型采样器偏离标准流匹配ODE，其短且低随机性的轨迹对初始化噪声高度敏感，使得中间SDE探索无效。
AI.method: 提出AR-CoPO框架，将Neighbor GRPO的对比视角适配到流式AR生成。引入分块级对齐机制：在随机选择的块处构建邻域候选，分配序列级奖励，并执行局部GRPO更新。还提出半在线策略训练策略，结合在线探索和参考轨迹回放缓冲区的利用。
AI.result: 在Self-Forcing上的实验表明，AR-CoPO在域外泛化和域内人类偏好对齐方面均优于基线，提供了真正对齐而非奖励破解的证据。
AI.conclusion: AR-CoPO为流式自回归视频生成器提供了一种有效的强化学习对齐框架，通过分块级对齐和半在线训练策略解决了现有方法的局限性，实现了更好的泛化和对齐性能。

title: FINER: MLLMs Hallucinate under Fine-grained Negative Queries
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with hallucinations, particularly with fine-grained queries, a challenge underrepresented by existing benchmarks that focus on coarse image-related questions. We introduce FIne-grained NEgative queRies (FINER), alongside two benchmarks: FINER-CompreCap and FINER-DOCCI. Using FINER, we analyze hallucinations across four settings: multi-object, multi-attribute, multi-relation, and ``what'' questions. Our benchmarks reveal that MLLMs hallucinate when fine-grained mismatches co-occur with genuinely present elements in the image. To address this, we propose FINER-Tuning, leveraging Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on FINER-inspired data. Finetuning four frontier MLLMs with FINER-Tuning yields up to 24.2\% gains (InternVL3.5-14B) on hallucinations from our benchmarks, while simultaneously improving performance on eight existing hallucination suites, and enhancing general multimodal capabilities across six benchmarks. Code, benchmark, and models are available at \href{https://explainableml.github.io/finer-project/}{https://explainableml.github.io/finer-project/}.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了FINER基准和FINER-Tuning方法，用于解决多模态大语言模型在细粒度查询中的幻觉问题，通过专门设计的负查询和直接偏好优化显著提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型在细粒度查询中存在严重的幻觉问题，而现有基准主要关注粗粒度的图像相关问题，无法充分评估和解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 提出了FINER（细粒度负查询）基准，包括FINER-CompreCap和FINER-DOCCI两个基准，涵盖多对象、多属性、多关系和"what"问题四种设置。同时提出了FINER-Tuning方法，利用直接偏好优化在FINER启发数据上进行微调。
AI.result: 在四个前沿MLLMs上应用FINER-Tuning，在幻觉基准上获得了高达24.2%的提升（InternVL3.5-14B），同时在八个现有幻觉测试套件上表现更好，并在六个多模态基准上提升了通用能力。
AI.conclusion: FINER基准有效揭示了MLLMs在细粒度查询中的幻觉模式，FINER-Tuning方法能显著减少幻觉并提升模型的多模态能力，为细粒度幻觉问题提供了有效的解决方案。

title: WeatherReasonSeg: A Benchmark for Weather-Aware Reasoning Segmentation in Visual Language Models
summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in reasoning-based segmentation. However, current benchmarks are primarily constructed from high-quality images captured under idealized conditions. This raises a critical question: when visual cues are severely degraded by adverse weather conditions such as rain, snow, or fog, can VLMs sustain reliable reasoning segmentation capabilities? In response to this challenge, we introduce WeatherReasonSeg, a benchmark designed to evaluate VLM performance in reasoning-based segmentation under adverse weather conditions. It consists of two complementary components. First, we construct a controllable reasoning dataset by applying synthetic weather with varying severity levels to existing segmentation datasets, enabling fine-grained robustness analysis. Second, to capture real-world complexity, we curate a real-world adverse-weather reasoning segmentation dataset with semantically consistent queries generated via mask-guided LLM prompting. We further broaden the evaluation scope across five reasoning dimensions, including functionality, application scenarios, structural attributes, interactions, and requirement matching. Extensive experiments across diverse VLMs reveal two key findings: (1) VLM performance degrades monotonically with increasing weather severity, and (2) different weather types induce distinct vulnerability patterns. We hope WeatherReasonSeg will serve as a foundation for advancing robust, weather-aware reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了WeatherReasonSeg基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在恶劣天气条件下的推理分割性能，包含合成和真实数据集，揭示了模型性能随天气严重程度单调下降且不同天气类型导致不同脆弱性模式
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在推理分割方面表现出色，但当前基准主要基于理想条件下的高质量图像。当恶劣天气（如雨、雪、雾）严重降低视觉线索时，VLMs能否保持可靠的推理分割能力？这是需要解决的关键问题。
AI.method: 提出WeatherReasonSeg基准，包含两个互补组件：1）通过对现有分割数据集应用不同严重程度的合成天气构建可控推理数据集；2）通过掩码引导的LLM提示生成语义一致的查询，构建真实世界恶劣天气推理分割数据集。评估范围涵盖五个推理维度：功能、应用场景、结构属性、交互和需求匹配。
AI.result: 对多种VLMs的广泛实验揭示了两个关键发现：1）VLM性能随着天气严重程度的增加而单调下降；2）不同的天气类型会导致不同的脆弱性模式。
AI.conclusion: WeatherReasonSeg基准为推进稳健、天气感知的推理提供了基础，有助于评估和改进视觉语言模型在恶劣天气条件下的推理分割能力。

title: Eye image segmentation using visual and concept prompts with Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3)
summary: Previous work has reported that vision foundation models show promising zero-shot performance in eye image segmentation. Here we examine whether the latest iteration of the Segment Anything Model, SAM3, offers better eye image segmentation performance than SAM2, and explore the performance of its new concept (text) prompting mode. Eye image segmentation performance was evaluated using diverse datasets encompassing both high-resolution high-quality videos from a lab environment and the TEyeD dataset consisting of challenging eye videos acquired in the wild. Results show that in most cases SAM3 with either visual or concept prompts did not perform better than SAM2, for both lab and in-the-wild datasets. Since SAM2 not only performed better but was also faster, we conclude that SAM2 remains the best option for eye image segmentation. We provide our adaptation of SAM3's codebase that allows processing videos of arbitrary duration.

AI.tldr: SAM3在眼图像分割任务中表现不如SAM2，无论是视觉提示还是文本提示模式，且处理速度更慢，因此SAM2仍是眼图像分割的最佳选择。
AI.motivation: 评估最新的Segment Anything Model (SAM3)在眼图像分割任务中是否比SAM2表现更好，并探索其新的文本提示模式在眼图像分割中的性能。
AI.method: 使用多样化的眼图像数据集进行评估，包括实验室环境的高分辨率高质量视频和野外采集的具有挑战性的TEyeD数据集。比较SAM3与SAM2在视觉提示和文本提示模式下的分割性能。
AI.result: 在大多数情况下，无论是实验室数据集还是野外数据集，SAM3（无论是视觉提示还是文本提示模式）的表现都不如SAM2。SAM2不仅性能更好，而且处理速度更快。
AI.conclusion: SAM2仍然是眼图像分割的最佳选择。研究团队提供了能够处理任意时长视频的SAM3代码库适配版本。

title: UAV-CB: A Complex-Background RGB-T Dataset and Local Frequency Bridge Network for UAV Detection
summary: Detecting Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in low-altitude environments is essential for perception and defense systems but remains highly challenging due to complex backgrounds, camouflage, and multimodal interference. In real-world scenarios, UAVs are frequently visually blended with surrounding structures such as buildings, vegetation, and power lines, resulting in low contrast, weak boundaries, and strong confusion with cluttered background textures. Existing UAV detection datasets, though diverse, are not specifically designed to capture these camouflage and complex-background challenges, which limits progress toward robust real-world perception. To fill this gap, we construct UAV-CB, a new RGB-T UAV detection dataset deliberately curated to emphasize complex low-altitude backgrounds and camouflage characteristics. Furthermore, we propose the Local Frequency Bridge Network (LFBNet), which models features in localized frequency space to bridge both the frequency-spatial fusion gap and the cross-modality discrepancy gap in RGB-T fusion. Extensive experiments on UAV-CB and public benchmarks demonstrate that LFBNet achieves state-of-the-art detection performance and strong robustness under camouflaged and cluttered conditions, offering a frequency-aware perspective on multimodal UAV perception in real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个专门针对复杂低空背景和伪装特性的RGB-T无人机检测数据集UAV-CB，并设计了局部频率桥接网络LFBNet，通过局部频率空间建模来解决频率-空间融合差距和跨模态差异问题，在伪装和杂乱条件下实现了最先进的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 在低空环境中检测无人机对于感知和防御系统至关重要，但由于复杂背景、伪装和多模态干扰而极具挑战性。现有无人机检测数据集虽然多样，但未专门针对这些伪装和复杂背景挑战设计，限制了实际感知系统的鲁棒性发展。
AI.method: 构建了专门强调复杂低空背景和伪装特性的RGB-T无人机检测数据集UAV-CB；提出了局部频率桥接网络LFBNet，在局部频率空间中对特征进行建模，以桥接频率-空间融合差距和跨模态差异差距。
AI.result: 在UAV-CB数据集和公共基准测试上的大量实验表明，LFBNet在伪装和杂乱条件下实现了最先进的检测性能和强大的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了专门针对复杂背景和伪装挑战的无人机检测数据集的空白，提出的LFBNet为实际应用中的多模态无人机感知提供了频率感知的新视角，在复杂低空环境中表现出优异的检测性能。

title: SARE: Sample-wise Adaptive Reasoning for Training-free Fine-grained Visual Recognition
summary: Recent advances in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have enabled training-free Fine-Grained Visual Recognition (FGVR). However, effectively exploiting LVLMs for FGVR remains challenging due to the inherent visual ambiguity of subordinate-level categories. Existing methods predominantly adopt either retrieval-oriented or reasoning-oriented paradigms to tackle this challenge, but both are constrained by two fundamental limitations:(1) They apply the same inference pipeline to all samples without accounting for uneven recognition difficulty, thereby leading to suboptimal accuracy and efficiency; (2) The lack of mechanisms to consolidate and reuse error-specific experience causes repeated failures on similar challenging cases. To address these limitations, we propose SARE, a Sample-wise Adaptive textbfREasoning framework for training-free FGVR. Specifically, SARE adopts a cascaded design that combines fast candidate retrieval with fine-grained reasoning, invoking the latter only when necessary. In the reasoning process, SARE incorporates a self-reflective experience mechanism that leverages past failures to provide transferable discriminative guidance during inference, without any parameter updates. Extensive experiments across 14 datasets substantiate that SARE achieves state-of-the-art performance while substantially reducing computational overhead.

AI.tldr: SARE是一个样本自适应推理框架，通过级联设计结合快速候选检索和细粒度推理，仅在必要时调用推理过程，并利用自反思经验机制重用错误经验，在训练自由的细粒度视觉识别中实现了最优性能并显著降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在利用大型视觉语言模型进行细粒度视觉识别时面临两个基本限制：1）对所有样本采用相同的推理流程，没有考虑识别难度的不均匀性，导致准确性和效率不理想；2）缺乏整合和重用错误特定经验的机制，导致在类似挑战性案例上重复失败。
AI.method: SARE采用级联设计，结合快速候选检索与细粒度推理，仅在必要时调用推理过程。在推理过程中，SARE引入自反思经验机制，利用过去的失败经验在推理过程中提供可转移的判别性指导，无需任何参数更新。
AI.result: 在14个数据集上的广泛实验证实，SARE实现了最先进的性能，同时显著降低了计算开销。
AI.conclusion: SARE通过样本自适应推理框架有效解决了细粒度视觉识别中的挑战，通过级联设计和经验重用机制在保持高性能的同时提高了效率。

title: Omni-I2C: A Holistic Benchmark for High-Fidelity Image-to-Code Generation
summary: We present Omni-I2C, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in converting complex, structured digital graphics into executable code. We argue that this task represents a non-trivial challenge for the current generation of LMMs: it demands an unprecedented synergy between high-fidelity visual perception -- to parse intricate spatial hierarchies and symbolic details -- and precise generative expression -- to synthesize syntactically sound and logically consistent code. Unlike traditional descriptive tasks, Omni-I2C requires a holistic understanding where any minor perceptual hallucination or coding error leads to a complete failure in visual reconstruction. Omni-I2C features 1080 meticulously curated samples, defined by its breadth across subjects, image modalities, and programming languages. By incorporating authentic user-sourced cases, the benchmark spans a vast spectrum of digital content -- from scientific visualizations to complex symbolic notations -- each paired with executable reference code. To complement this diversity, our evaluation framework provides necessary depth; by decoupling performance into perceptual fidelity and symbolic precision, it transcends surface-level accuracy to expose the granular structural failures and reasoning bottlenecks of current LMMs. Our evaluation reveals a substantial performance gap among leading LMMs; even state-of-the-art models struggle to preserve structural integrity in complex scenarios, underscoring that multimodal code generation remains a formidable challenge. Data and code are available at https://github.com/MiliLab/Omni-I2C.

AI.tldr: Omni-I2C是一个评估大型多模态模型将复杂结构化数字图形转换为可执行代码能力的基准测试，包含1080个精心设计的样本，涵盖多种主题、图像模态和编程语言。
AI.motivation: 当前大型多模态模型在将复杂结构化数字图形转换为可执行代码方面面临重大挑战，这需要高保真视觉感知和精确代码生成的协同配合，而现有基准测试无法充分评估这种能力。
AI.method: 创建包含1080个样本的综合基准测试，涵盖科学可视化到复杂符号表示等多种数字内容，每个样本都配有可执行参考代码。评估框架将性能解耦为感知保真度和符号精度两个维度。
AI.result: 评估显示领先的大型多模态模型之间存在显著性能差距，即使最先进的模型在复杂场景中也难以保持结构完整性，表明多模态代码生成仍然是一个严峻挑战。
AI.conclusion: Omni-I2C基准测试揭示了当前大型多模态模型在将复杂数字图形转换为可执行代码方面的局限性，为未来模型改进提供了重要评估工具和方向。

title: UniSem: Generalizable Semantic 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Unposed Images
summary: Semantic-aware 3D reconstruction from sparse, unposed images remains challenging for feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Existing methods often predict an over-complete set of Gaussian primitives under sparse-view supervision, leading to unstable geometry and inferior depth quality. Meanwhile, they rely solely on 2D segmenter features for semantic lifting, which provides weak 3D-level and limited generalizable supervision, resulting in incomplete 3D semantics in novel scenes. To address these issues, we propose UniSem, a unified framework that jointly improves depth accuracy and semantic generalization via two key components. First, Error-aware Gaussian Dropout (EGD) performs error-guided capacity control by suppressing redundancy-prone Gaussians using rendering error cues, producing meaningful, geometrically stable Gaussian representations for improved depth estimation. Second, we introduce a Mix-training Curriculum (MTC) that progressively blends 2D segmenter-lifted semantics with the model's own emergent 3D semantic priors, implemented with object-level prototype alignment to enhance semantic coherence and completeness. Extensive experiments on ScanNet and Replica show that UniSem achieves superior performance in depth prediction and open-vocabulary 3D segmentation across varying numbers of input views. Notably, with 16-view inputs, UniSem reduces depth Rel by 15.2% and improves open-vocabulary segmentation mAcc by 3.7% over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: UniSem框架通过误差感知高斯丢弃和混合训练课程，从稀疏无位姿图像中提升3D重建的深度精度和语义泛化能力
AI.motivation: 现有基于前馈3D高斯泼溅的方法在稀疏视图下预测过多高斯基元，导致几何不稳定和深度质量差；同时仅依赖2D分割器特征进行语义提升，提供弱3D级监督，导致新场景中3D语义不完整
AI.method: 1. 误差感知高斯丢弃(EGD)：利用渲染误差线索抑制冗余倾向的高斯基元，实现误差引导的容量控制；2. 混合训练课程(MTC)：逐步融合2D分割器提升的语义与模型自身涌现的3D语义先验，通过对象级原型对齐增强语义一致性和完整性
AI.result: 在ScanNet和Replica数据集上的实验表明，UniSem在深度预测和开放词汇3D分割方面表现优异。使用16个输入视图时，深度相对误差降低15.2%，开放词汇分割平均准确率提升3.7%
AI.conclusion: UniSem通过联合优化几何和语义表示，有效解决了稀疏视图3D重建中的深度精度和语义泛化问题，为语义感知的3D重建提供了统一框架

title: Fine-Grained Post-Training Quantization for Large Vision Language Models with Quantization-Aware Integrated Gradients
summary: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable success in a range of downstream tasks that require multimodal interaction, but their capabilities come with substantial computational and memory overhead, which hinders practical deployment. Among numerous acceleration techniques, post-training quantization is a popular and effective strategy for reducing memory cost and accelerating inference. However, existing LVLM quantization methods typically measure token sensitivity at the modality level, which fails to capture the complex cross-token interactions and falls short in quantitatively measuring the quantization error at the token level. As tokens interact within the model, the distinction between modalities gradually diminishes, suggesting the need for fine-grained calibration. Inspired by axiomatic attribution in mechanistic interpretability, we introduce a fine-grained quantization strategy on Quantization-aware Integrated Gradients (QIG), which leverages integrated gradients to quantitatively evaluate token sensitivity and push the granularity from modality level to token level, reflecting both inter-modality and intra-modality dynamics. Extensive experiments on multiple LVLMs under both W4A8 and W3A16 settings show that our method improves accuracy across models and benchmarks with negligible latency overhead. For example, under 3-bit weight-only quantization, our method improves the average accuracy of LLaVA-onevision-7B by 1.60%, reducing the gap to its full-precision counterpart to only 1.33%. The code is available at https://github.com/ucas-xiang/QIG.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于量化感知集成梯度的细粒度量化策略QIG，用于大型视觉语言模型，通过将量化粒度从模态级别提升到令牌级别来减少量化误差，在多种量化设置下显著提升了模型精度。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型虽然在下游任务中表现出色，但存在巨大的计算和内存开销，阻碍了实际部署。现有的量化方法通常在模态级别测量令牌敏感性，无法捕捉复杂的跨令牌交互，也无法在令牌级别定量测量量化误差。随着令牌在模型内交互，模态之间的区别逐渐减弱，需要更细粒度的校准。
AI.method: 受机制可解释性中公理归因的启发，提出了基于量化感知集成梯度的细粒度量化策略QIG。该方法利用集成梯度来定量评估令牌敏感性，将量化粒度从模态级别提升到令牌级别，同时反映模态间和模态内的动态变化。
AI.result: 在多种LVLM模型和W4A8、W3A16量化设置下的大量实验表明，该方法在不同模型和基准测试中都提高了准确性，且延迟开销可忽略不计。例如，在3位仅权重量化下，该方法将LLaVA-onevision-7B的平均准确率提高了1.60%，使其与全精度版本的差距缩小到仅1.33%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的QIG方法通过细粒度的令牌级量化策略，有效解决了现有LVLM量化方法在跨令牌交互和量化误差测量方面的不足，显著提升了量化后模型的性能，为大型视觉语言模型的实用部署提供了有效的量化解决方案。

title: PCA-Seg: Revisiting Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic and Part Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have garnered substantial attention in open-vocabulary semantic and part segmentation (OSPS). However, existing methods extract image-text alignment cues from cost volumes through a serial structure of spatial and class aggregations, leading to knowledge interference between class-level semantics and spatial context. Therefore, this paper proposes a simple yet effective parallel cost aggregation (PCA-Seg) paradigm to alleviate the above challenge, enabling the model to capture richer vision-language alignment information from cost volumes. Specifically, we design an expert-driven perceptual learning (EPL) module that efficiently integrates semantic and contextual streams. It incorporates a multi-expert parser to extract complementary features from multiple perspectives. In addition, a coefficient mapper is designed to adaptively learn pixel-specific weights for each feature, enabling the integration of complementary knowledge into a unified and robust feature embedding. Furthermore, we propose a feature orthogonalization decoupling (FOD) strategy to mitigate redundancy between the semantic and contextual streams, which allows the EPL module to learn diverse knowledge from orthogonalized features. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks show that each parallel block in PCA-Seg adds merely 0.35M parameters while achieving state-of-the-art OSPS performance.

AI.tldr: PCA-Seg提出并行成本聚合范式，通过专家驱动感知学习模块和特征正交化解耦策略，解决现有方法中类别语义与空间上下文知识干扰问题，在开放词汇语义和部件分割任务上实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在开放词汇语义和部件分割中采用串行空间和类别聚合结构，导致类别级语义与空间上下文知识相互干扰，限制了视觉语言对齐信息的有效提取。
AI.method: 提出并行成本聚合范式PCA-Seg：1）专家驱动感知学习模块，包含多专家解析器提取多视角互补特征，系数映射器自适应学习像素特定权重；2）特征正交化解耦策略，减少语义流和上下文流之间的冗余，从正交化特征中学习多样化知识。
AI.result: 在8个基准测试上验证，PCA-Seg每个并行块仅增加0.35M参数，但实现了最先进的开放词汇语义和部件分割性能。
AI.conclusion: PCA-Seg通过并行成本聚合范式有效缓解了类别语义与空间上下文的知识干扰问题，能够从成本体积中捕获更丰富的视觉语言对齐信息，为开放词汇分割任务提供了简单而有效的解决方案。

title: ChopGrad: Pixel-Wise Losses for Latent Video Diffusion via Truncated Backpropagation
summary: Recent video diffusion models achieve high-quality generation through recurrent frame processing where each frame generation depends on previous frames. However, this recurrent mechanism means that training such models in the pixel domain incurs prohibitive memory costs, as activations accumulate across the entire video sequence. This fundamental limitation also makes fine-tuning these models with pixel-wise losses computationally intractable for long or high-resolution videos. This paper introduces ChopGrad, a truncated backpropagation scheme for video decoding, limiting gradient computation to local frame windows while maintaining global consistency. We provide a theoretical analysis of this approximation and show that it enables efficient fine-tuning with frame-wise losses. ChopGrad reduces training memory from scaling linearly with the number of video frames (full backpropagation) to constant memory, and compares favorably to existing state-of-the-art video diffusion models across a suite of conditional video generation tasks with pixel-wise losses, including video super-resolution, video inpainting, video enhancement of neural-rendered scenes, and controlled driving video generation.

AI.tldr: ChopGrad是一种用于视频扩散模型的截断反向传播方案，通过限制梯度计算到局部帧窗口来大幅降低训练内存消耗，同时保持全局一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前视频扩散模型采用循环帧处理机制，在像素域训练时由于激活值在整个视频序列中累积，导致内存成本过高。这一根本限制使得使用像素级损失对长视频或高分辨率视频进行微调在计算上不可行。
AI.method: 提出ChopGrad截断反向传播方案，将梯度计算限制在局部帧窗口内，同时保持全局一致性。提供了该近似方法的理论分析，证明其能够实现基于帧级损失的高效微调。
AI.result: ChopGrad将训练内存从与视频帧数线性缩放（完整反向传播）降低到恒定内存。在多种条件视频生成任务中表现优异，包括视频超分辨率、视频修复、神经渲染场景的视频增强以及受控驾驶视频生成。
AI.conclusion: ChopGrad通过截断反向传播解决了视频扩散模型训练中的内存瓶颈问题，使得使用像素级损失对长视频和高分辨率视频进行高效微调成为可能，在多个视频生成任务中取得了与现有最先进模型相媲美的性能。

title: MM-OVSeg:Multimodal Optical-SAR Fusion for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation in Remote Sensing
summary: Open-vocabulary segmentation enables pixel-level recognition from an open set of textual categories, allowing generalization beyond fixed classes. Despite great potential in remote sensing, progress in this area remains largely limited to clear-sky optical data and struggles under cloudy or haze-contaminated conditions. We present MM-OVSeg, a multimodal Optical-SAR fusion framework for resilient open-vocabulary segmentation under adverse weather conditions. MM-OVSeg leverages the complementary strengths of the two modalities--optical imagery provides rich spectral semantics, while synthetic aperture radar (SAR) offers cloud-penetrating structural cues. To address the cross-modal domain gap and the limited dense prediction capability of current vision-language models, we propose two key designs: a cross-modal unification process for multi-sensor representation alignment, and a dual-encoder fusion module that integrates hierarchical features from multiple vision foundation models for text-aligned multimodal segmentation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MM-OVSeg achieves superior robustness and generalization across diverse cloud conditions. The source dataset and code are available here.

AI.tldr: MM-OVSeg是一个多模态光学-SAR融合框架，用于恶劣天气条件下的开放词汇分割，通过结合光学图像的丰富光谱语义和SAR的云穿透结构线索，实现了跨模态表示对齐和多层次特征融合。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇分割在遥感领域具有巨大潜力，但现有方法主要局限于晴空光学数据，在云层或雾霾污染条件下表现不佳。需要一种能够应对恶劣天气条件的鲁棒性分割方法。
AI.method: 提出了MM-OVSeg多模态光学-SAR融合框架，包含两个关键设计：1）跨模态统一过程用于多传感器表示对齐；2）双编码器融合模块，集成来自多个视觉基础模型的分层特征，实现文本对齐的多模态分割。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MM-OVSeg在不同云层条件下实现了卓越的鲁棒性和泛化能力，在恶劣天气条件下的开放词汇分割任务中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: MM-OVSeg通过有效融合光学和SAR数据的互补优势，解决了现有开放词汇分割方法在恶劣天气条件下的局限性，为遥感领域的多模态分割提供了新的解决方案。

title: Temporal Gains, Spatial Costs: Revisiting Video Fine-Tuning in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are typically trained in multiple stages, with video-based supervised fine-tuning (Video-SFT) serving as a key step for improving visual understanding. Yet its effect on the fine-grained evolution of visual capabilities, particularly the balance between spatial and temporal understanding, remains poorly understood. In this paper, we systematically study how Video-SFT reshapes visual capabilities in MLLMs. Across architectures, parameter scales, and frame sampling settings, we observe a consistent pattern: Video-SFT reliably improves video performance, but often yields limited gains or even degradation on static image benchmarks. We further show that this trade-off is closely tied to temporal budget: increasing the number of sampled frames generally improves video performance, but does not reliably improve static image performance. Motivated by this finding, we study an instruction-aware Hybrid-Frame strategy that adaptively allocates frame counts and partially mitigates the image-video trade-off. Our results indicate that Video-SFT is not a free lunch for MLLMs, and preserving spatial understanding remains a central challenge in joint image-video training.

AI.tldr: Video-SFT训练能提升MLLMs的视频理解能力，但会损害静态图像性能，这种权衡与时间预算（采样帧数）密切相关
AI.motivation: 研究视频监督微调（Video-SFT）如何影响多模态大语言模型的视觉能力演化，特别是空间理解（静态图像）与时间理解（视频）之间的平衡关系
AI.method: 系统研究不同架构、参数规模和帧采样设置下的Video-SFT效果，分析时间预算（采样帧数）对性能的影响，并提出指令感知的混合帧策略来部分缓解图像-视频权衡
AI.result: Video-SFT能可靠提升视频性能，但对静态图像基准测试的增益有限甚至会导致性能下降；增加采样帧数通常能改善视频性能，但不能可靠提升静态图像性能
AI.conclusion: Video-SFT并非MLLMs的免费午餐，在联合图像-视频训练中保持空间理解能力仍然是一个核心挑战

title: ProGVC: Progressive-based Generative Video Compression via Auto-Regressive Context Modeling
summary: Perceptual video compression leverages generative priors to reconstruct realistic textures and motions at low bitrates. However, existing perceptual codecs often lack native support for variable bitrate and progressive delivery, and their generative modules are weakly coupled with entropy coding, limiting bitrate reduction. Inspired by the next-scale prediction in the Visual Auto-Regressive (VAR) models, we propose ProGVC, a Progressive-based Generative Video Compression framework that unifies progressive transmission, efficient entropy coding, and detail synthesis within a single codec. ProGVC encodes videos into hierarchical multi-scale residual token maps, enabling flexible rate adaptation by transmitting a coarse-to-fine subset of scales in a progressive manner. A Transformer-based multi-scale autoregressive context model estimates token probabilities, utilized both for efficient entropy coding of the transmitted tokens and for predicting truncated fine-scale tokens at the decoder to restore perceptual details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that as a new coding paradigm, ProGVC delivers promising perceptual compression performance at low bitrates while offering practical scalability at the same time.

AI.tldr: ProGVC是一个基于渐进传输的生成式视频压缩框架，通过多尺度残差令牌映射和Transformer自回归上下文模型，实现了低比特率下的感知压缩和灵活的速率适应。
AI.motivation: 现有感知视频编解码器缺乏对可变比特率和渐进传输的原生支持，且生成模块与熵编码弱耦合，限制了比特率降低。需要一种统一渐进传输、高效熵编码和细节合成的编解码器。
AI.method: 提出ProGVC框架：1）将视频编码为分层多尺度残差令牌映射，支持渐进传输；2）使用基于Transformer的多尺度自回归上下文模型估计令牌概率；3）该模型既用于传输令牌的高效熵编码，也用于在解码器预测截断的细尺度令牌以恢复感知细节。
AI.result: 实验表明，ProGVC作为一种新的编码范式，在低比特率下提供了有前景的感知压缩性能，同时具有实际可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: ProGVC成功统一了渐进传输、高效熵编码和细节合成，实现了低比特率下的感知视频压缩，并提供了灵活的速率适应能力。

title: VideoAtlas: Navigating Long-Form Video in Logarithmic Compute
summary: Extending language models to video introduces two challenges: representation, where existing methods rely on lossy approximations, and long-context, where caption- or agent-based pipelines collapse video into text and lose visual fidelity. To overcome this, we introduce \textbf{VideoAtlas}, a task-agnostic environment to represent video as a hierarchical grid that is simultaneously lossless, navigable, scalable, caption- and preprocessing-free. An overview of the video is available at a glance, and any region can be recursively zoomed into, with the same visual representation used uniformly for the video, intermediate investigations, and the agent's memory, eliminating lossy text conversion end-to-end. This hierarchical structure ensures access depth grows only logarithmically with video length. For long-context, Recursive Language Models (RLMs) recently offered a powerful solution for long text, but extending them to visual domain requires a structured environment to recurse into, which \textbf{VideoAtlas} provides. \textbf{VideoAtlas} as a Markov Decision Process unlocks Video-RLM: a parallel Master-Worker architecture where a Master coordinates global exploration while Workers concurrently drill into assigned regions to accumulate lossless visual evidence. We demonstrate three key findings: (1)~logarithmic compute growth with video duration, further amplified by a 30-60\% multimodal cache hit rate arising from the grid's structural reuse. (2)~environment budgeting, where bounding the maximum exploration depth provides a principled compute-accuracy hyperparameter. (3)~emergent adaptive compute allocation that scales with question granularity. When scaling from 1-hour to 10-hour benchmarks, Video-RLM remains the most duration-robust method with minimal accuracy degradation, demonstrating that structured environment navigation is a viable and scalable paradigm for video understanding.

AI.tldr: VideoAtlas：一种任务无关的视频层次化网格表示方法，结合递归语言模型实现对数级计算增长的长视频理解
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型面临两大挑战：表示方法依赖有损近似，以及长上下文处理中基于字幕或代理的流水线会丢失视觉保真度
AI.method: 提出VideoAtlas作为任务无关环境，将视频表示为层次化网格；结合递归语言模型(RLM)构建Video-RLM架构，采用Master-Worker并行架构进行全局探索与局部深入
AI.result: 实现对数级计算增长（与视频时长）；30-60%多模态缓存命中率；环境预算控制提供计算-精度超参数；自适应计算分配随问题粒度扩展；在1小时到10小时基准测试中保持最稳健性能
AI.conclusion: 结构化环境导航是视频理解的可扩展范式，VideoAtlas提供无损、可导航、可扩展的视频表示，结合RLM实现长视频的高效理解

title: Unified Spatio-Temporal Token Scoring for Efficient Video VLMs
summary: Token pruning is essential for enhancing the computational efficiency of vision-language models (VLMs), particularly for video-based tasks where temporal redundancy is prevalent. Prior approaches typically prune tokens either (1) within the vision transformer (ViT) exclusively for unimodal perception tasks such as action recognition and object segmentation, without adapting to downstream vision-language tasks; or (2) only within the LLM while leaving the ViT output intact, often requiring complex text-conditioned token selection mechanisms. In this paper, we introduce Spatio-Temporal Token Scoring (STTS), a simple and lightweight module that prunes vision tokens across both the ViT and the LLM without text conditioning or token merging, and is fully compatible with end-to-end training. By learning how to score temporally via an auxiliary loss and spatially via LLM downstream gradients, aided by our efficient packing algorithm, STTS prunes 50% of vision tokens throughout the entire architecture, resulting in a 62% improvement in efficiency during both training and inference with only a 0.7% drop in average performance across 13 short and long video QA tasks. Efficiency gains increase with more sampled frames per video. Applying test-time scaling for long-video QA further yields performance gains of 0.5-1% compared to the baseline. Overall, STTS represents a novel, simple yet effective technique for unified, architecture-wide vision token pruning.

AI.tldr: STTS提出了一种简单轻量的时空令牌评分模块，可在ViT和LLM中同时剪枝视觉令牌，无需文本条件或令牌合并，实现端到端训练，在13个视频QA任务上剪枝50%视觉令牌，效率提升62%，性能仅下降0.7%
AI.motivation: 现有令牌剪枝方法存在局限性：要么只在ViT中剪枝但未适配下游视觉语言任务，要么只在LLM中剪枝但需要复杂的文本条件令牌选择机制。视频任务中存在显著的时间冗余，需要一种统一、简单且有效的架构级视觉令牌剪枝方法。
AI.method: 提出时空令牌评分（STTS）模块，通过辅助损失学习时间评分，通过LLM下游梯度学习空间评分，结合高效打包算法，在ViT和LLM中同时剪枝视觉令牌，无需文本条件或令牌合并，完全兼容端到端训练。
AI.result: 在13个短/长视频QA任务上，剪枝50%视觉令牌，训练和推理效率提升62%，平均性能仅下降0.7%。效率增益随视频采样帧数增加而增加。长视频QA测试时缩放进一步带来0.5-1%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: STTS是一种新颖、简单而有效的统一架构级视觉令牌剪枝技术，显著提升视觉语言模型的计算效率，特别适用于视频任务，在保持性能的同时大幅减少计算开销。

title: ReLaGS: Relational Language Gaussian Splatting
summary: Achieving unified 3D perception and reasoning across tasks such as segmentation, retrieval, and relation understanding remains challenging, as existing methods are either object-centric or rely on costly training for inter-object reasoning. We present a novel framework that constructs a hierarchical language-distilled Gaussian scene and its 3D semantic scene graph without scene-specific training. A Gaussian pruning mechanism refines scene geometry, while a robust multi-view language alignment strategy aggregates noisy 2D features into accurate 3D object embeddings. On top of this hierarchy, we build an open-vocabulary 3D scene graph with Vision Language derived annotations and Graph Neural Network-based relational reasoning. Our approach enables efficient and scalable open-vocabulary 3D reasoning by jointly modeling hierarchical semantics and inter/intra-object relationships, validated across tasks including open-vocabulary segmentation, scene graph generation, and relation-guided retrieval. Project page: https://dfki-av.github.io/ReLaGS/

AI.tldr: 提出ReLaGS框架，通过构建层次化语言蒸馏高斯场景和3D语义场景图，实现无需场景特定训练的统一3D感知与推理
AI.motivation: 现有3D感知方法要么是物体中心的，要么需要昂贵的训练来进行物体间推理，难以实现跨分割、检索和关系理解等任务的统一3D感知与推理
AI.method: 1) 构建层次化语言蒸馏高斯场景；2) 高斯剪枝机制优化场景几何；3) 鲁棒多视角语言对齐策略聚合噪声2D特征为准确3D物体嵌入；4) 构建开放词汇3D场景图，使用视觉语言标注和图神经网络进行关系推理
AI.result: 在开放词汇分割、场景图生成和关系引导检索等任务上验证了方法的有效性，实现了高效可扩展的开放词汇3D推理
AI.conclusion: 通过联合建模层次语义和物体内/间关系，实现了无需场景特定训练的统一3D感知与推理框架

title: S-VGGT: Structure-Aware Subscene Decomposition for Scalable 3D Foundation Models
summary: Feed-forward 3D foundation models face a key challenge: the quadratic computational cost introduced by global attention, which severely limits scalability as input length increases. Concurrent acceleration methods, such as token merging, operate at the token level. While they offer local savings, the required nearest-neighbor searches introduce undesirable overhead. Consequently, these techniques fail to tackle the fundamental issue of structural redundancy dominant in dense capture data. In this work, we introduce \textbf{S-VGGT}, a novel approach that addresses redundancy at the structural frame level, drastically shifting the optimization focus. We first leverage the initial features to build a dense scene graph, which characterizes structural scene redundancy and guides the subsequent scene partitioning. Using this graph, we softly assign frames to a small number of subscenes, guaranteeing balanced groups and smooth geometric transitions. The core innovation lies in designing the subscenes to share a common reference frame, establishing a parallel geometric bridge that enables independent and highly efficient processing without explicit geometric alignment. This structural reorganization provides strong intrinsic acceleration by cutting the global attention cost at its source. Crucially, S-VGGT is entirely orthogonal to token-level acceleration methods, allowing the two to be seamlessly combined for compounded speedups without compromising reconstruction fidelity. Code is available at https://github.com/Powertony102/S-VGGT.

AI.tldr: S-VGGT是一种针对3D基础模型的新型加速方法，通过在结构帧层面处理冗余问题，而非传统的token层面，从而显著降低全局注意力计算的二次方成本。
AI.motivation: 前馈式3D基础模型面临全局注意力带来的二次方计算成本问题，限制了模型的可扩展性。现有的token层面加速方法（如token合并）虽然能提供局部节省，但需要最近邻搜索引入额外开销，且未能解决密集捕获数据中占主导地位的结构冗余问题。
AI.method: S-VGGT首先利用初始特征构建密集场景图，表征结构场景冗余并指导后续场景分区。然后使用该图将帧软分配到少量子场景中，确保平衡分组和平滑几何过渡。核心创新在于设计子场景共享共同参考帧，建立并行几何桥梁，实现独立高效处理而无需显式几何对齐。
AI.result: 该方法通过从源头削减全局注意力成本提供强大的内在加速。重要的是，S-VGGT与token层面加速方法完全正交，可以无缝结合实现复合加速，同时不损害重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: S-VGGT通过结构层面的优化解决了3D基础模型的关键计算瓶颈，提供了一种新颖的加速方法，能够与现有技术结合实现显著性能提升，代码已开源。

title: Part-Aware Open-Vocabulary 3D Affordance Grounding via Prototypical Semantic and Geometric Alignment
summary: Grounding natural language questions to functionally relevant regions in 3D objects -- termed language-driven 3D affordance grounding -- is essential for embodied intelligence and human-AI interaction. Existing methods, while progressing from label-based to language-driven approaches, still face challenges in open-vocabulary generalization, fine-grained geometric alignment, and part-level semantic consistency. To address these issues, we propose a novel two-stage cross-modal framework that enhances both semantic and geometric representations for open-vocabulary 3D affordance grounding. In the first stage, large language models generate part-aware instructions to recover missing semantics, enabling the model to link semantically similar affordances. In the second stage, we introduce two key components: Affordance Prototype Aggregation (APA), which captures cross-object geometric consistency for each affordance, and Intra-Object Relational Modeling (IORM), which refines geometric differentiation within objects to support precise semantic alignment. We validate the effectiveness of our method through extensive experiments on a newly introduced benchmark, as well as two existing benchmarks, demonstrating superior performance in comparison with existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种两阶段跨模态框架，用于开放词汇3D功能基础任务，通过大语言模型生成部件感知指令恢复缺失语义，并引入APA和IORM组件增强几何表示
AI.motivation: 现有方法在开放词汇泛化、细粒度几何对齐和部件级语义一致性方面存在挑战，需要改进3D功能基础任务
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段使用大语言模型生成部件感知指令恢复语义；第二阶段引入APA捕获跨对象几何一致性，IORM细化对象内几何差异以支持精确语义对齐
AI.result: 在新引入的基准测试和两个现有基准测试上进行了广泛实验，证明了与现有方法相比的优越性能
AI.conclusion: 提出的两阶段跨模态框架有效解决了开放词汇3D功能基础任务中的语义和几何表示挑战

title: Few-Step Diffusion Sampling Through Instance-Aware Discretizations
summary: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-fidelity data by simulating paths defined by Ordinary or Stochastic Differential Equations (ODEs/SDEs), starting from a tractable prior distribution. The probability flow ODE formulation enables the use of advanced numerical solvers to accelerate sampling. Orthogonal yet vital to solver design is the discretization strategy. While early approaches employed handcrafted heuristics and recent methods adopt optimization-based techniques, most existing strategies enforce a globally shared timestep schedule across all samples. This uniform treatment fails to account for instance-specific complexity in the generative process, potentially limiting performance. Motivated by controlled experiments on synthetic data, which reveals the suboptimality of global schedules under instance-specific dynamics, we propose an instance-aware discretization framework. Our method learns to adapt timestep allocations based on input-dependent priors, extending gradient-based discretization search to the conditional generative setting. Empirical results across diverse settings, including synthetic data, pixel-space diffusion, latent-space images and video flow matching models, demonstrate that our method consistently improves generation quality with marginal tuning cost compared to training and negligible inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种实例感知的离散化框架，通过学习基于输入相关先验调整时间步分配，在条件生成设置中扩展基于梯度的离散化搜索，相比全局共享时间步调度能提升生成质量
AI.motivation: 现有扩散和流匹配模型大多采用全局共享的时间步调度策略，未能考虑生成过程中实例特定的复杂性，限制了性能。在合成数据上的控制实验揭示了全局调度在实例特定动态下的次优性
AI.method: 提出实例感知离散化框架，学习基于输入相关先验调整时间步分配，将基于梯度的离散化搜索扩展到条件生成设置
AI.result: 在合成数据、像素空间扩散、潜在空间图像和视频流匹配模型等多种设置中，该方法一致提高了生成质量，相比训练仅有边际调整成本，推理开销可忽略
AI.conclusion: 实例感知的离散化策略能够有效解决全局时间步调度的局限性，通过考虑实例特定复杂性提升生成模型的性能，为扩散和流匹配模型的离散化设计提供了新思路

title: Illumination-Aware Contactless Fingerprint Spoof Detection via Paired Flash-Non-Flash Imaging
comment: Accepted at IWBF 2026 (14th International Workshop on Biometrics and Forensics)
summary: Contactless fingerprint recognition enables hygienic and convenient biometric authentication but poses new challenges for spoof detection due to the absence of physical contact and traditional liveness cues. Most existing methods rely on single-image acquisition and appearance-based features, which often generalize poorly across devices, capture conditions, and spoof materials. In this work, we study paired flash-non-flash contactless fingerprint acquisition as a lightweight active sensing mechanism for spoof detection. Through a preliminary empirical analysis, we show that flash illumination accentuates material- and structure-dependent properties, including ridge visibility, subsurface scattering, micro-geometry, and surface oils, while non-flash images provide a baseline appearance context. We analyze lighting-induced differences using interpretable metrics such as inter-channel correlation, specular reflection characteristics, texture realism, and differential imaging. These complementary features help discriminate genuine fingerprints from printed, digital, and molded presentation attacks. We further examine the limitations of paired acquisition, including sensitivity to imaging settings, dataset scale, and emerging high-fidelity spoofs. Our findings demonstrate the potential of illumination-aware analysis to improve robustness and interpretability in contactless fingerprint presentation attack detection, motivating future work on paired acquisition and physics-informed feature design. Code is available in the repository.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索使用闪光-非闪光配对采集作为接触式指纹防伪检测的轻量级主动感知机制，通过光照变化增强材料依赖特征来区分真实指纹与伪造攻击。
AI.motivation: 接触式指纹识别虽然卫生方便，但缺乏物理接触和传统活体检测线索，现有单图像采集方法在不同设备、采集条件和伪造材料上泛化能力差，需要更鲁棒的防伪检测方法。
AI.method: 采用闪光-非闪光配对采集作为主动感知机制，通过可解释指标分析光照诱导差异：通道间相关性、镜面反射特性、纹理真实性和差分成像，利用互补特征区分真实指纹与打印、数字和模具伪造攻击。
AI.result: 闪光照明增强了材料依赖特性（脊线可见性、次表面散射、微观几何和表面油分），与非闪光图像形成互补，这些特征能有效区分真实指纹与各种伪造攻击，但存在对成像设置敏感、数据集规模有限和高保真伪造等局限性。
AI.conclusion: 光照感知分析能提高接触式指纹呈现攻击检测的鲁棒性和可解释性，为未来配对采集和物理信息特征设计提供了方向，代码已开源。

title: Does YOLO Really Need to See Every Training Image in Every Epoch?
summary: YOLO detectors are known for their fast inference speed, yet training them remains unexpectedly time-consuming due to their exhaustive pipeline that processes every training image in every epoch, even when many images have already been sufficiently learned. This stands in clear contrast to the efficiency suggested by the ``You Only Look Once'' philosophy. This naturally raises an important question: \textit{Does YOLO really need to see every training image in every epoch?} To explore this, we propose an Anti-Forgetting Sampling Strategy (AFSS) that dynamically determines which images should be used and which can be skipped during each epoch, allowing the detector to learn more effectively and efficiently. Specifically, AFSS measures the learning sufficiency of each training image as the minimum of its detection recall and precision, and dynamically categorizes training images into easy, medium, or hard levels accordingly. Easy training images are sparsely resampled during training in a continuous review manner, with priority given to those that have not been used for a long time to reduce redundancy and prevent forgetting. Moderate training images are partially selected, prioritizing recently unused ones and randomly choosing the rest from unselected images to ensure coverage and prevent forgetting. Hard training images are fully sampled in every epoch to ensure sufficient learning. The learning sufficiency of each training image is periodically updated, enabling detectors to adaptively shift its focus toward the informative training images over time while progressively discarding redundant ones. On widely used natural image detection benchmarks (MS COCO 2017 and PASCAL VOC 2007) and remote sensing detection datasets (DOTA-v1.0 and DIOR-R), AFSS achieves more than $1.43\times$ training speedup for YOLO-series detectors while also improving accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出AFSS采样策略，动态选择训练图像，跳过已充分学习的图像，加速YOLO训练同时提升精度
AI.motivation: YOLO检测器推理速度快但训练耗时，因为每个epoch都要处理所有训练图像，即使很多图像已经充分学习，这与"只看一次"的效率理念不符
AI.method: 提出抗遗忘采样策略(AFSS)，通过检测召回率和精度的最小值衡量图像学习充分度，将图像动态分为简单、中等、困难三个等级。简单图像稀疏重采样，中等图像部分选择，困难图像每个epoch都采样，并定期更新学习充分度
AI.result: 在MS COCO 2017、PASCAL VOC 2007、DOTA-v1.0和DIOR-R数据集上，AFSS为YOLO系列检测器实现超过1.43倍的训练加速，同时提高准确率
AI.conclusion: AFSS策略有效解决了YOLO训练效率问题，通过动态采样机制让检测器专注于信息丰富的训练图像，在加速训练的同时提升性能

title: Learning Transferable Temporal Primitives for Video Reasoning via Synthetic Videos
summary: The transition from image to video understanding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to shift from recognizing static patterns to reasoning over temporal dynamics such as motion trajectories, speed changes, and state transitions. Yet current post-training methods fall short due to two critical limitations: (1) existing datasets often lack temporal-centricity, where answers can be inferred from isolated keyframes rather than requiring holistic temporal integration; and (2) training data generated by proprietary models contains systematic errors in fundamental temporal perception, such as confusing motion directions or misjudging speeds. We introduce SynRL, a post-training framework that teaches models temporal primitives, the fundamental building blocks of temporal understanding including direction, speed, and state tracking. Our key insight is that these abstract primitives, learned from programmatically generated synthetic videos, transfer effectively to real-world scenarios. We decompose temporal understanding into short-term perceptual primitives (speed, direction) and long-term cognitive primitives, constructing 7.7K CoT and 7K RL samples with ground-truth frame-level annotations through code-based video generation. Despite training on simple geometric shapes, SynRL achieves substantial improvements across 15 benchmarks spanning temporal grounding, complex reasoning, and general video understanding. Remarkably, our 7.7K synthetic CoT samples outperform Video-R1 with 165K real-world samples. We attribute this to fundamental temporal skills, such as tracking frame by frame changes and comparing velocity, that transfer effectively from abstract synthetic patterns to complex real-world scenarios. This establishes a new paradigm for video post-training: video temporal learning through carefully designed synthetic data provides a more cost efficient scaling path.

AI.tldr: SynRL是一个通过合成视频数据训练视觉语言模型时序理解能力的后训练框架，使用程序生成的简单几何形状视频教授方向、速度、状态跟踪等时序原语，在少量合成数据上超越了使用大量真实视频数据的现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型从图像理解转向视频理解时面临两个关键局限：1）现有数据集缺乏时序中心性，答案可以从孤立的关键帧推断而不需要整体时序整合；2）由专有模型生成的训练数据在基本时序感知方面存在系统性错误，如混淆运动方向或误判速度。
AI.method: 提出SynRL后训练框架，通过程序生成的合成视频教授模型时序原语（方向、速度、状态跟踪等基本构建块）。将时序理解分解为短期感知原语（速度、方向）和长期认知原语，通过代码生成视频构建了7.7K CoT和7K RL样本，并带有真实帧级标注。
AI.result: 尽管在简单几何形状上训练，SynRL在15个基准测试（包括时序定位、复杂推理和通用视频理解）上取得显著改进。仅用7.7K合成CoT样本就超越了使用165K真实世界样本的Video-R1方法，表明从抽象合成模式到复杂现实场景的有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的合成数据进行视频时序学习为视频后训练提供了新的范式，这是一种更经济高效的扩展路径。从合成视频中学习的基本时序技能（如逐帧跟踪变化和比较速度）能够有效迁移到现实世界场景。

title: TAPESTRY: From Geometry to Appearance via Consistent Turntable Videos
summary: Automatically generating photorealistic and self-consistent appearances for untextured 3D models is a critical challenge in digital content creation. The advancement of large-scale video generation models offers a natural approach: directly synthesizing 360-degree turntable videos (TTVs), which can serve not only as high-quality dynamic previews but also as an intermediate representation to drive texture synthesis and neural rendering. However, existing general-purpose video diffusion models struggle to maintain strict geometric consistency and appearance stability across the full range of views, making their outputs ill-suited for high-quality 3D reconstruction. To this end, we introduce TAPESTRY, a framework for generating high-fidelity TTVs conditioned on explicit 3D geometry. We reframe the 3D appearance generation task as a geometry-conditioned video diffusion problem: given a 3D mesh, we first render and encode multi-modal geometric features to constrain the video generation process with pixel-level precision, thereby enabling the creation of high-quality and consistent TTVs. Building upon this, we also design a method for downstream reconstruction tasks from the TTV input, featuring a multi-stage pipeline with 3D-Aware Inpainting. By rotating the model and performing a context-aware secondary generation, this pipeline effectively completes self-occluded regions to achieve full surface coverage. The videos generated by TAPESTRY are not only high-quality dynamic previews but also serve as a reliable, 3D-aware intermediate representation that can be seamlessly back-projected into UV textures or used to supervise neural rendering methods like 3DGS. This enables the automated creation of production-ready, complete 3D assets from untextured meshes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both video consistency and final reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: TAPESTRY框架通过几何条件视频扩散生成高质量360度转盘视频，用于无纹理3D模型的逼真外观生成和重建。
AI.motivation: 为无纹理3D模型自动生成逼真且自一致的外观是数字内容创建的关键挑战。现有通用视频扩散模型难以保持严格的几何一致性和跨视角的外观稳定性，不适合高质量的3D重建。
AI.method: 将3D外观生成任务重构为几何条件视频扩散问题：给定3D网格，首先渲染并编码多模态几何特征，以像素级精度约束视频生成过程。设计了用于下游重建任务的多阶段流程，包括3D感知修复，通过旋转模型和执行上下文感知的二次生成来补全自遮挡区域。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在视频一致性和最终重建质量方面均优于现有方法。生成的视频不仅是高质量的动态预览，还可作为可靠的3D感知中间表示，无缝反投影到UV纹理或用于监督神经渲染方法。
AI.conclusion: TAPESTRY框架能够从无纹理网格自动创建生产就绪的完整3D资产，通过几何条件视频扩散生成高质量的360度转盘视频，解决了现有方法在几何一致性和外观稳定性方面的不足。

title: Evidence Packing for Cross-Domain Image Deepfake Detection with LVLMs
summary: Image Deepfake Detection (IDD) separates manipulated images from authentic ones by spotting artifacts of synthesis or tampering. Although large vision-language models (LVLMs) offer strong image understanding, adapting them to IDD often demands costly fine-tuning and generalizes poorly to diverse, evolving manipulations. We propose the Semantic Consistent Evidence Pack (SCEP), a training-free LVLM framework that replaces whole-image inference with evidence-driven reasoning. SCEP mines a compact set of suspicious patch tokens that best reveal manipulation cues. It uses the vision encoder's CLS token as a global reference, clusters patch features into coherent groups, and scores patches with a fused metric combining CLS-guided semantic mismatch with frequency-and noise-based anomalies. To cover dispersed traces and avoid redundancy, SCEP samples a few high-confidence patches per cluster and applies grid-based NMS, producing an evidence pack that conditions a frozen LVLM for prediction. Experiments on diverse benchmarks show SCEP outperforms strong baselines without LVLM fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出SCEP框架，无需训练即可让大型视觉语言模型进行图像深度伪造检测，通过挖掘可疑补丁证据包来替代全图推理
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在图像理解方面强大，但直接用于深度伪造检测需要昂贵的微调，且对多样化和不断演变的篡改操作泛化能力差
AI.method: SCEP框架：1) 使用视觉编码器的CLS令牌作为全局参考；2) 将补丁特征聚类为连贯组；3) 使用融合度量（CLS引导的语义不匹配+频率和噪声异常）对补丁评分；4) 从每个聚类采样高置信度补丁并应用基于网格的NMS，生成证据包；5) 用证据包条件化冻结的LVLM进行预测
AI.result: 在多样化基准测试中，SCEP无需LVLM微调即超越强基线方法
AI.conclusion: SCEP提供了一种无需训练的证据驱动推理框架，有效解决了LVLM在深度伪造检测中的微调成本和泛化问题

title: CrowdGaussian: Reconstructing High-Fidelity 3D Gaussians for Human Crowd from a Single Image
summary: Single-view 3D human reconstruction has garnered significant attention in recent years. Despite numerous advancements, prior research has concentrated on reconstructing 3D models from clear, close-up images of individual subjects, often yielding subpar results in the more prevalent multi-person scenarios. Reconstructing 3D human crowd models is a highly intricate task, laden with challenges such as: 1) extensive occlusions, 2) low clarity, and 3) numerous and various appearances. To address this task, we propose CrowdGaussian, a unified framework that directly reconstructs multi-person 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representations from single-image inputs. To handle occlusions, we devise a self-supervised adaptation pipeline that enables the pretrained large human model to reconstruct complete 3D humans with plausible geometry and appearance from heavily occluded inputs. Furthermore, we introduce Self-Calibrated Learning (SCL). This training strategy enables single-step diffusion models to adaptively refine coarse renderings to optimal quality by blending identity-preserving samples with clean/corrupted image pairs. The outputs can be distilled back to enhance the quality of multi-person 3DGS representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CrowdGaussian generates photorealistic, geometrically coherent reconstructions of multi-person scenes.

AI.tldr: CrowdGaussian：从单张图像直接重建多人3D高斯溅射表示的框架，通过自监督适应处理遮挡，使用自校准学习优化渲染质量
AI.motivation: 现有单视图3D人体重建研究主要关注清晰、近距离的单人图像，在更常见的多人场景中表现不佳。多人3D人群重建面临三大挑战：1）严重遮挡，2）低清晰度，3）多样外观
AI.method: 提出CrowdGaussian统一框架，直接从单张图像重建多人3D高斯溅射表示。采用自监督适应管道处理遮挡，使预训练大型人体模型能从严重遮挡输入重建完整3D人体。引入自校准学习训练策略，让单步扩散模型自适应地将粗糙渲染优化到最佳质量
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CrowdGaussian能够生成照片级真实感、几何一致的多人物场景重建
AI.conclusion: CrowdGaussian有效解决了多人3D重建的挑战，通过自监督适应和自校准学习实现了高质量的多人场景重建

title: ResNet-50 with Class Reweighting and Anatomy-Guided Temporal Decoding for Gastrointestinal Video Analysis
summary: We developed a multi-label gastrointestinal video analysis pipeline based on a ResNet-50 frame classifier followed by anatomy-guided temporal event decoding. The system predicts 17 labels, including 5 anatomy classes and 12 pathology classes, from frames resized to 336x336. A major challenge was severe class imbalance, particularly for rare pathology labels. To address this, we used clipped class-wise positive weighting in the training loss, which improved rare-class learning while maintaining stable optimization. At the temporal stage, we found that direct frame-to-event conversion produced fragmented mismatches with the official ground truth. The final submission therefore combined GT-style framewise event composition, anatomy vote smoothing, and anatomy-based pathology gating with a conservative hysteresis decoder. This design improved the final temporal mAP from 0.3801 to 0.4303 on the challenge test set.

AI.tldr: 开发了一个基于ResNet-50帧分类器和解剖引导时间事件解码的多标签胃肠道视频分析管道，用于预测17个标签（5个解剖类别和12个病理类别），通过剪裁类正权重和保守滞后解码器解决了类别不平衡和事件碎片化问题。
AI.motivation: 胃肠道视频分析面临两个主要挑战：严重的类别不平衡（特别是罕见病理标签）以及帧级预测到时间事件转换时的碎片化不匹配问题，需要开发有效的解决方案来提升多标签分类和时间事件检测性能。
AI.method: 1. 使用ResNet-50作为帧分类器，输入图像尺寸为336x336；2. 采用剪裁类正权重训练损失函数来处理类别不平衡问题；3. 时间事件解码阶段结合了GT风格帧级事件组合、解剖投票平滑和基于解剖的病理门控；4. 使用保守滞后解码器优化时间事件检测。
AI.result: 在挑战测试集上，时间平均精度（mAP）从0.3801提升到0.4303，表明所提出的方法在时间事件检测方面取得了显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 提出的多标签胃肠道视频分析管道通过有效的类别不平衡处理策略和精心设计的时间事件解码方法，显著提升了罕见病理检测和时间事件识别的性能，为医学视频分析提供了实用解决方案。

title: M2P: Improving Visual Foundation Models with Mask-to-Point Weakly-Supervised Learning for Dense Point Tracking
summary: Tracking Any Point (TAP) has emerged as a fundamental tool for video understanding. Current approaches adapt Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) like DINOv2 via offline finetuning or test-time optimization. However, these VFMs rely on static image pre-training, which is inherently sub-optimal for capturing dense temporal correspondence in videos. To address this, we propose Mask-to-Point (M2P) learning, which leverages rich video object segmentation (VOS) mask annotations to improve VFMs for dense point tracking. Our M2P introduces three new mask-based constraints for weakly-supervised representation learning. First, we propose a local structure consistency loss, which leverages Procrustes analysis to model the cohesive motion of points lying within a local structure, achieving more reliable point-to-point matching learning. Second, we propose a mask label consistency (MLC) loss, which enforces that sampled foreground points strictly match foreground regions across frames. The proposed MLC loss can be regarded as a regularization, which stabilizes training and prevents convergence to trivial solutions. Finally, mask boundary constrain is applied to explicitly supervise boundary points. We show that our weaklysupervised M2P models significantly outperform baseline VFMs with efficient training by using only 3.6K VOS training videos. Notably, M2P achieves 12.8% and 14.6% performance gains over DINOv2-B/14 and DINOv3-B/16 on the TAP-Vid-DAVIS benchmark, respectively. Moreover, the proposed M2P models are used as pre-trained backbones for both test-time optimized and offline fine-tuned TAP tasks, demonstrating its potential to serve as general pre-trained models for point tracking. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出Mask-to-Point (M2P)学习方法，利用视频对象分割标注改进视觉基础模型在密集点跟踪任务上的表现，通过三种掩码约束实现弱监督表征学习。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉基础模型基于静态图像预训练，不适合视频中的密集时间对应关系学习。需要利用视频数据改进模型在点跟踪任务上的表现。
AI.method: 提出M2P学习方法，包含三种掩码约束：1) 局部结构一致性损失，使用Procrustes分析建模局部结构内点的连贯运动；2) 掩码标签一致性损失，确保前景点严格匹配前景区域；3) 掩码边界约束，显式监督边界点。
AI.result: 仅使用3.6K个VOS训练视频，M2P模型显著超越基线VFMs。在TAP-Vid-DAVIS基准上，相比DINOv2-B/14和DINOv3-B/16分别提升12.8%和14.6%。M2P可作为点跟踪任务的通用预训练骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: M2P通过弱监督学习有效利用视频对象分割标注改进视觉基础模型在密集点跟踪任务上的表现，为点跟踪任务提供了高质量的预训练模型。

title: Steering Video Diffusion Transformers with Massive Activations
summary: Despite rapid progress in video diffusion transformers, how their internal model signals can be leveraged with minimal overhead to enhance video generation quality remains underexplored. In this work, we study the role of Massive Activations (MAs), which are rare, high-magnitude hidden state spikes in video diffusion transformers. We observed that MAs emerge consistently across all visual tokens, with a clear magnitude hierarchy: first-frame tokens exhibit the largest MA magnitudes, latent-frame boundary tokens (the head and tail portions of each temporal chunk in the latent space) show elevated but slightly lower MA magnitudes than the first frame, and interior tokens within each latent frame remain elevated, yet are comparatively moderate in magnitude. This structured pattern suggests that the model implicitly prioritizes token positions aligned with the temporal chunking in the latent space. Based on this observation, we propose Structured Activation Steering (STAS), a training-free self-guidance-like method that steers MA values at first-frame and boundary tokens toward a scaled global maximum reference magnitude. STAS achieves consistent improvements in terms of video quality and temporal coherence across different text-to-video models, while introducing negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 论文提出STAS方法，通过引导视频扩散变换器中罕见的高幅度隐藏状态尖峰（Massive Activations）来提升视频生成质量，无需额外训练且计算开销极小。
AI.motivation: 尽管视频扩散变换器发展迅速，但如何利用其内部模型信号以最小开销提升视频生成质量仍未被充分探索。本文研究了Massive Activations（MAs）——视频扩散变换器中罕见的高幅度隐藏状态尖峰的作用。
AI.method: 观察到MAs在所有视觉标记中一致出现，具有清晰的幅度层次：首帧标记幅度最大，潜在帧边界标记（潜在空间时间块的首尾部分）幅度较高但略低于首帧，内部标记幅度中等。基于此提出Structured Activation Steering（STAS），这是一种无需训练的自引导方法，将首帧和边界标记的MA值引导至缩放后的全局最大参考幅度。
AI.result: STAS在不同文本到视频模型中均实现了视频质量和时间一致性的持续改进，同时引入的计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 视频扩散变换器中的Massive Activations具有结构化模式，模型隐含地优先考虑与潜在空间时间分块对齐的标记位置。利用这一观察提出的STAS方法能有效提升视频生成质量。

title: TINA: Text-Free Inversion Attack for Unlearned Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Although text-to-image diffusion models exhibit remarkable generative power, concept erasure techniques are essential for their safe deployment to prevent the creation of harmful content. This has fostered a dynamic interplay between the development of erasure defenses and the adversarial probes designed to bypass them, and this co-evolution has progressively enhanced the efficacy of erasure methods. However, this adversarial co-evolution has converged on a narrow, text-centric paradigm that equates erasure with severing the text-to-image mapping, ignoring that the underlying visual knowledge related to undesired concepts still persist. To substantiate this claim, we investigate from a visual perspective, leveraging DDIM inversion to probe whether a generative pathway for the erased concept can still be found. However, identifying such a visual generative pathway is challenging because standard text-guided DDIM inversion is actively resisted by text-centric defenses within the erased model. To address this, we introduce TINA, a novel Text-free INversion Attack, which enforces this visual-only probe by operating under a null-text condition, thereby avoiding existing text-centric defenses. Moreover, TINA integrates an optimization procedure to overcome the accumulating approximation errors that arise when standard inversion operates without its usual textual guidance. Our experiments demonstrate that TINA regenerates erased concepts from models treated with state-of-the-art unlearning. The success of TINA proves that current methods merely obscure concepts, highlighting an urgent need for paradigms that operate directly on internal visual knowledge.

AI.tldr: TINA是一种文本自由的反演攻击方法，能够绕过现有基于文本的概念擦除防御，证明当前擦除方法只是掩盖概念而非真正消除视觉知识。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到图像扩散模型的概念擦除技术主要关注切断文本到图像的映射，但忽略了底层视觉知识仍然存在。需要从视觉角度验证擦除是否真正有效。
AI.method: 提出TINA（Text-free INversion Attack），在零文本条件下使用DDIM反演来寻找被擦除概念的视觉生成路径，并通过优化过程克服无文本指导时的累积近似误差。
AI.result: TINA成功从经过最先进遗忘处理的模型中重新生成被擦除的概念，证明当前擦除方法只是掩盖概念而非真正消除内部视觉知识。
AI.conclusion: 当前基于文本的概念擦除方法存在根本缺陷，需要开发直接操作内部视觉知识的新范式，才能真正实现概念消除。

title: Video Understanding: From Geometry and Semantics to Unified Models
comment: A comprehensive survey of video understanding, spanning low-level geometry, high-level semantics, and unified understanding models
summary: Video understanding aims to enable models to perceive, reason about, and interact with the dynamic visual world. In contrast to image understanding, video understanding inherently requires modeling temporal dynamics and evolving visual context, placing stronger demands on spatiotemporal reasoning and making it a foundational problem in computer vision. In this survey, we present a structured overview of video understanding by organizing the literature into three complementary perspectives: low-level video geometry understanding, high-level semantic understanding, and unified video understanding models. We further highlight a broader shift from isolated, task-specific pipelines toward unified modeling paradigms that can be adapted to diverse downstream objectives, enabling a more systematic view of recent progress. By consolidating these perspectives, this survey provides a coherent map of the evolving video understanding landscape, summarizes key modeling trends and design principles, and outlines open challenges toward building robust, scalable, and unified video foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文对视频理解领域进行了结构化综述，从低层几何理解、高层语义理解和统一模型三个互补视角组织文献，总结了从任务特定管道向统一建模范式的转变趋势。
AI.motivation: 视频理解需要建模时间动态和演化视觉上下文，比图像理解对时空推理要求更高，是计算机视觉的基础问题。本文旨在通过结构化综述为领域提供系统概览。
AI.method: 将文献组织为三个互补视角：低层视频几何理解、高层语义理解、统一视频理解模型。强调从任务特定管道向统一建模范式的转变。
AI.result: 提供了视频理解领域的连贯图景，总结了关键建模趋势和设计原则，为构建稳健、可扩展的统一视频基础模型奠定了基础。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合三个视角，本文为视频理解领域提供了系统概览，总结了从孤立任务特定管道向统一建模范式的转变，并指出了构建统一视频基础模型的开放挑战。

title: Omni-3DEdit: Generalized Versatile 3D Editing in One-Pass
summary: Most instruction-driven 3D editing methods rely on 2D models to guide the explicit and iterative optimization of 3D representations. This paradigm, however, suffers from two primary drawbacks. First, it lacks a universal design of different 3D editing tasks because the explicit manipulation of 3D geometry necessitates task-dependent rules, e.g., 3D appearance editing demands inherent source 3D geometry, while 3D removal alters source geometry. Second, the iterative optimization process is highly time-consuming, often requiring thousands of invocations of 2D/3D updating. We present Omni-3DEdit, a unified, learning-based model that generalizes various 3D editing tasks implicitly. One key challenge to achieve our goal is the scarcity of paired source-edited multi-view assets for training. To address this issue, we construct a data pipeline, synthesizing a relatively rich number of high-quality paired multi-view editing samples. Subsequently, we adapt the pre-trained generative model SEVA as our backbone by concatenating source view latents along with conditional tokens in sequence space. A dual-stream LoRA module is proposed to disentangle different view cues, largely enhancing our model's representational learning capability. As a learning-based model, our model is free of the time-consuming online optimization, and it can complete various 3D editing tasks in one forward pass, reducing the inference time from tens of minutes to approximately two minutes. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of Omni-3DEdit.

AI.tldr: Omni-3DEdit是一个统一的基于学习的3D编辑模型，通过一次前向传播即可完成多种3D编辑任务，将推理时间从数十分钟减少到约两分钟。
AI.motivation: 现有基于指令驱动的3D编辑方法依赖2D模型指导3D表示的显式迭代优化，存在两个主要问题：1）缺乏针对不同3D编辑任务的通用设计，因为3D几何的显式操作需要任务相关规则；2）迭代优化过程非常耗时，通常需要数千次2D/3D更新调用。
AI.method: 构建数据管道合成高质量配对多视图编辑样本；采用预训练生成模型SEVA作为骨干网络，在序列空间中连接源视图潜在表示和条件标记；提出双流LoRA模块来解耦不同视图线索，增强模型表示学习能力。
AI.result: Omni-3DEdit能够完成各种3D编辑任务，无需耗时的在线优化，通过一次前向传播即可完成编辑，将推理时间从数十分钟减少到约两分钟。大量实验证明了该方法的有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: Omni-3DEdit是一个统一的基于学习的3D编辑模型，通过解决训练数据稀缺问题并采用创新的架构设计，实现了高效、通用的3D编辑，显著提升了编辑速度和任务通用性。

title: Revisiting foundation models for cell instance segmentation
summary: Cell segmentation is a fundamental task in microscopy image analysis. Several foundation models for cell segmentation have been introduced, virtually all of them are extensions of Segment Anything Model (SAM), improving it for microscopy data. Recently, SAM2 and SAM3 have been published, further improving and extending the capabilities of general-purpose segmentation foundation models. Here, we comprehensively evaluate foundation models for cell segmentation (CellPoseSAM, CellSAM, $μ$SAM) and for general-purpose segmentation (SAM, SAM2, SAM3) on a diverse set of (light) microscopy datasets, for tasks including cell, nucleus and organoid segmentation. Furthermore, we introduce a new instance segmentation strategy called automatic prompt generation (APG) that can be used to further improve SAM-based microscopy foundation models. APG consistently improves segmentation results for $μ$SAM, which is used as the base model, and is competitive with the state-of-the-art model CellPoseSAM. Moreover, our work provides important lessons for adaptation strategies of SAM-style models to microscopy and provides a strategy for creating even more powerful microscopy foundation models. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/computational-cell-analytics/micro-sam.

AI.tldr: 该研究全面评估了细胞分割基础模型（CellPoseSAM、CellSAM、μSAM）和通用分割模型（SAM、SAM2、SAM3）在多种显微镜数据集上的性能，并提出了自动提示生成（APG）策略来改进基于SAM的显微镜基础模型。
AI.motivation: 细胞分割是显微镜图像分析的基础任务，虽然已有多个基于Segment Anything Model（SAM）的细胞分割基础模型，但新发布的SAM2和SAM3进一步提升了通用分割能力。需要系统评估这些模型在显微镜数据上的表现，并探索改进策略。
AI.method: 1）在多样化的（光）显微镜数据集上全面评估细胞分割基础模型和通用分割模型；2）提出自动提示生成（APG）实例分割策略，用于改进基于SAM的显微镜基础模型；3）以μSAM为基础模型应用APG策略。
AI.result: APG策略持续改善了μSAM的分割结果，使其与最先进的CellPoseSAM模型具有竞争力。研究为SAM风格模型在显微镜领域的适应策略提供了重要经验，并为创建更强大的显微镜基础模型提供了策略。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为显微镜图像分割领域提供了全面的模型评估和改进策略，APG方法有效提升了基于SAM的显微镜基础模型的性能，为开发更强大的显微镜基础模型指明了方向。代码已公开可用。

title: VISER: Visually-Informed System for Enhanced Robustness in Open-Set Iris Presentation Attack Detection
summary: Human perceptual priors have shown promise in saliency-guided deep learning training, particularly in the domain of iris presentation attack detection (PAD). Common saliency approaches include hand annotations obtained via mouse clicks and eye gaze heatmaps derived from eye tracking data. However, the most effective form of human saliency for open-set iris PAD remains underexplored. In this paper, we conduct a series of experiments comparing hand annotations, eye tracking heatmaps, segmentation masks, and DINOv2 embeddings to a state-of-the-art deep learning-based baseline on the task of open-set iris PAD. Results for open-set PAD in a leave-one-attack-type out paradigm indicate that denoised eye tracking heatmaps show the best generalization improvement over cross entropy in terms of Area Under the ROC curve (AUROC) and Attack Presentation Classification Error Rate (APCER) at Bona Fide Presentation Classification Error Rate (BPCER) of 1%. Along with this paper, we offer trained models, code, and saliency maps for reproducibility and to facilitate follow-up research efforts.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了不同人类感知先验（手绘标注、眼动热图、分割掩码和DINOv2嵌入）在开放集虹膜呈现攻击检测中的效果，发现去噪眼动热图在AUROC和APCER指标上表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 人类感知先验在显著性引导的深度学习训练中显示出潜力，特别是在虹膜呈现攻击检测领域。然而，对于开放集虹膜PAD任务，最有效的人类显著性形式尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 通过一系列实验比较手绘标注、眼动热图、分割掩码和DINOv2嵌入，并与最先进的深度学习基线进行对比。采用留一攻击类型出的范式进行开放集PAD评估。
AI.result: 在开放集PAD任务中，去噪眼动热图在ROC曲线下面积和APCER指标上显示出最佳的泛化改进效果，优于交叉熵基线。
AI.conclusion: 去噪眼动热图是开放集虹膜呈现攻击检测中最有效的人类显著性形式，研究提供了训练模型、代码和显著性图以促进后续研究。

title: Edit Spillover as a Probe: Do Image Editing Models Implicitly Understand World Relations?
summary: Instruction-following image editing models are expected to modify only the specified region while keeping the rest of the image unchanged. However, in practice, we observe a pervasive phenomenon -- edit spillover: models alter semantically related but unspecified content outside the edit region. This raises a fundamental question -- does spillover reflect genuine implicit world understanding, or is it merely attention leakage? We propose EditSpilloverProbe, a systematic framework that repurposes edit spillover as a natural probe for world knowledge in image editing models. We introduce a spillover taxonomy (spatial, semantic, mixed, random), an automated detection-and-classification pipeline, and a benchmark dataset constructed from real-world Chinese text editing tasks, EditSpilloverBench. Systematic evaluation of 5 representative editing models reveals three core findings: (1) spillover rates vary dramatically across architectures, from 3.49% to 11.46%, with a 3.3x ratio; (2) absolute semantic spillover quantity reveals models' world understanding capability -- nano_banana produces the most semantic spillover (27.8 per image), while qwen_2511 has the most precise editing control but lower semantic spillover (16.3 per image), revealing a trade-off between editing control and world understanding; (3) spatial decay analysis shows spillover area density decays exponentially with distance, but the proportion of semantically relevant spillover remains constant (40%-58%), providing direct evidence that semantic spillover reflects genuine world understanding rather than spatial diffusion.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EditSpilloverProbe框架，将图像编辑模型中的"编辑溢出"现象重新定义为评估模型世界知识的自然探针，通过系统评估揭示了编辑控制与世界理解之间的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 指令跟随图像编辑模型在实践中普遍存在"编辑溢出"现象，即模型会修改指定编辑区域之外的语义相关内容。本研究旨在探究这一现象的本质：它反映的是模型真正的隐式世界理解能力，还是仅仅是注意力泄漏？
AI.method: 提出EditSpilloverProbe系统框架，包括：1）编辑溢出分类法（空间、语义、混合、随机）；2）自动化检测与分类流程；3）基于真实中文文本编辑任务构建的基准数据集EditSpilloverBench；4）对5个代表性编辑模型进行系统评估。
AI.result: 1）不同架构模型的溢出率差异显著（3.49%到11.46%，相差3.3倍）；2）绝对语义溢出数量反映模型世界理解能力——nano_banana产生最多语义溢出（每图27.8个），而qwen_2511编辑控制最精确但语义溢出较少（每图16.3个）；3）空间衰减分析显示溢出区域密度随距离呈指数衰减，但语义相关溢出比例保持恒定（40%-58%），证明语义溢出反映真实世界理解而非空间扩散。
AI.conclusion: 编辑溢出现象可作为评估图像编辑模型世界理解能力的有效探针。研究发现编辑控制精度与世界理解能力之间存在权衡关系，语义溢出反映了模型真正的隐式知识而非简单的注意力泄漏，为理解模型内部表征提供了新视角。

title: Identity as Presence: Towards Appearance and Voice Personalized Joint Audio-Video Generation
summary: Recent advances have demonstrated compelling capabilities in synthesizing real individuals into generated videos, reflecting the growing demand for identity-aware content creation. Nevertheless, an openly accessible framework enabling fine-grained control over facial appearance and voice timbre across multiple identities remains unavailable. In this work, we present a unified and scalable framework for identity-aware joint audio-video generation, enabling high-fidelity and consistent personalization.
